title: Profiling a Frontier Agent with EBench: From Direct Control to Harness with Policy
title_zh: 用EBench剖析前沿智能体：从直接控制到带策略的运行框架

paragraphs.en: Frontier multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can control robots without robot-specific training, but how their capabilities compare and interact with post-trained vision-language-action (VLA) and world action model (WAM) policies across manipulation demands remains to be thoroughly evaluated. In this report, we evaluate GPT-6-Astra on EBench as the core of an agent that controls a robot through an agent harness under the same visual and proprioceptive observation protocol as post-trained policies. We study two agent configurations: direct control, in which the agent generates waypoint commands directly, and harness with policy, in which it can also invoke a post-trained VLA or WAM policy for action execution. Under direct control, the agent achieves competitive overall performance relative to post-trained policies. It leads on short-horizon tasks and exhibits the least performance variation across generalization dimensions, whereas it underperforms post-trained policies on long-horizon tasks, tabletop manipulation, and high-precision contact-rich tasks. In the harness with policy, invoking a post-trained VLA or WAM combines the complementary strengths of both components, raising overall task success to the level of the strongest compared post-trained policies while substantially reducing token cost. However, performance remains below the per-task upper bound of the standalone components due to suboptimal policy invocation, fixed-instruction execution without subgoals, and grasp disruption when the agent resumes control. Overall, our study characterizes the capability boundary of a frontier MLLM agent and suggests directions for improving future agent harness design. Project page: https://internrobotics.github.io/EBench-Astra-Tech-Report/ .
paragraphs.zh: 前沿多模态大语言模型（MLLM）无需机器人专属训练即可控制机器人，但其能力与经过后训练的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型和世界动作模型（WAM）策略在不同操作需求下的对比与协同方式，仍有待全面评估。 在本报告中，我们在 EBench 上评估 GPT-6-Astra，将其作为智能体的核心，通过智能体框架控制机器人，并采用与后训练策略相同的视觉与本体感觉观测协议。 我们研究了两种智能体配置：直接控制，即智能体直接生成路径点指令；带策略的框架，即智能体还可以调用后训练的 VLA 或 WAM 策略来执行动作。 在直接控制模式下，智能体相对于后训练策略取得了具有竞争力的整体性能。 智能体在短时程任务上领先，并且在各泛化维度上性能波动最小，但在长时程任务、桌面操作以及高精度接触密集型任务上表现不如后训练策略。 在带策略的框架中，调用后训练的 VLA 或 WAM 能够结合两者的互补优势，将整体任务成功率提升至所对比的最强后训练策略的水平，同时显著降低 token 开销。 然而，由于策略调用欠佳、缺少子目标的固定指令执行，以及智能体恢复控制时的抓取干扰，性能仍低于各独立组件的任务级上限。 总体而言，我们的研究刻画了前沿 MLLM 智能体的能力边界，并为改进未来的智能体框架设计提出了方向。 项目页面：https://internrobotics.github.io/EBench-Astra-Tech-Report/ 。

paragraphs.en: Transferring knowledge from large pretrained models to robotics has become a primary approach to general-purpose robot control ( Firoozi et al., 2025 ; Ma et al., 2026b ; Shen et al., 2026 ) . Vision-language-action (VLA) models adapt vision-language backbones for end-to-end visuomotor control ( Kim et al., 2025 ; Black et al., 2025b ; Black et al., 2025a ; Ma et al., 2026a ; GigaBrain Team et al., 2026 ; Yuan et al., 2026a ) , whereas world action models (WAMs) jointly model future visual dynamics and actions to utilize the physical and temporal priors of video generative models ( Ye et al., 2026 ; Kim et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026a ; Yuan et al., 2026b ; Wang et al., 2026b ; Cai et al., 2026a ) . Both approaches rely on post-training with robot manipulation trajectories: although effective within their training distributions, their generalization is bounded by the scale and diversity of collected robot data. By contrast, frontier multimodal large language models (MLLMs) acquire stronger emergent capabilities from massive-scale pretraining data, and this training scale remains costly to replicate with embodied data alone.
paragraphs.zh: 将大型预训练模型的知识迁移到机器人领域，已成为实现通用机器人控制的主要方法（Firoozi et al., 2025；Ma et al., 2026b；Shen et al., 2026）。 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型将视觉-语言骨干网络适配用于端到端的视觉运动控制（Kim et al., 2025；Black et al., 2025b；Black et al., 2025a；Ma et al., 2026a；GigaBrain Team et al., 2026；Yuan et al., 2026a），而世界动作模型（WAM）则联合建模未来视觉动态与动作，以利用视频生成模型的物理先验和时间先验（Ye et al., 2026；Kim et al., 2026；Li et al., 2026a；Yuan et al., 2026b；Wang et al., 2026b；Cai et al., 2026a）。 这两种方法都依赖于使用机器人操作轨迹进行后训练：尽管它们在训练分布内表现有效，但其泛化能力受限于所收集机器人数据的规模和多样性。 相比之下，前沿多模态大语言模型（MLLM）从大规模预训练数据中获得了更强的涌现能力，而仅依靠具身数据来复制这样的训练规模仍然成本高昂。

paragraphs.en: Without robot-specific post-training, frontier MLLMs provide an alternative approach through their spatial understanding and embodied reasoning capabilities ( Zhang et al., 2026a ; Rao, 2026 ) . GPT-6-Astra ( OpenAI, 2026 ) , for example, can generate end-effector (EEF) commands directly from camera observations and language instructions ( Zhang et al., 2026a ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Jia et al., 2026 ; Lou et al., 2026 ) . Combined with an agent harness that supplies its prompt, observation interface, and tools, the model serves as the core of an agent that controls the robot in closed loop, as formalized in Section 3 . Beyond direct control, recent studies explore a harness with policy in which the agent invokes a post-trained policy for action execution ( Zhang et al., 2026b ; Xu et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026a ) . Such a harness combines the agent’s task planning, progress monitoring, and error recovery with the closed-loop visuomotor control that the policy learns from robot demonstrations.
paragraphs.zh: 在没有针对机器人的后训练的情况下，前沿多模态大语言模型凭借其空间理解与具身推理能力提供了一种替代方案 ( Zhang et al., 2026a ; Rao, 2026 ) 。 例如，GPT-6-Astra ( OpenAI, 2026 ) 可以直接根据相机观测和语言指令生成末端执行器（EEF）指令 ( Zhang et al., 2026a ; Liu et al., 2026 ; Jia et al., 2026 ; Lou et al., 2026 ) 。 结合一个为其提供提示词、观测接口和工具的智能体框架，该模型作为智能体的核心，以闭环方式控制机器人，形式化定义见第 3 节。 除直接控制外，近期研究还探索了一种带策略的框架，其中智能体调用经后训练的策略来执行动作 ( Zhang et al., 2026b ; Xu et al., 2026 ; Wang et al., 2026a ) 。 这样的框架将智能体的任务规划、进度监控和错误恢复，与策略从机器人演示中学习到的闭环视觉运动控制相结合。

paragraphs.en: Although prior studies have evaluated both direct control and a harness with policy, they have not comprehensively profiled these agent configurations against post-trained VLA and WAM policies across diverse manipulation demands. Specifically, two central questions remain to be addressed. First, under direct control, on which tasks does the agent outperform post-trained VLAs and WAMs, where does it fall short, and what limits its performance? Second, in a harness-with-policy setting, how does invoking a post-trained policy complement the agent’s direct control, which limitations of direct control can it alleviate, and what new failure modes arise when the agent invokes a policy for execution and subsequently resumes decision-making?
paragraphs.zh: 尽管已有研究分别评估了直接控制和使用策略框架（harness）这两种方式，但尚未针对多样化的操作需求，系统性地将这些智能体配置与经过后训练的 VLA 和 WAM 策略进行全面对比。 具体而言，仍有两个核心问题亟待解决。 其一，在直接控制下，智能体在哪些任务上优于经过后训练的 VLA 和 WAM，在哪些方面存在不足，以及哪些因素限制了其性能？ 其二，在使用策略框架的设置下，调用经过后训练的策略如何补充智能体的直接控制，它能缓解直接控制的哪些局限，以及当智能体调用策略执行后再恢复决策时，会出现哪些新的失败模式？

paragraphs.en: To further explore these questions, we evaluate GPT-6-Astra as the core of an agent on EBench ( Gao et al., 2026 ) . This diagnostic manipulation benchmark categorizes tasks by mobility, manipulation precision, and task horizon and evaluates robustness along the generalization dimensions of unseen objects, unseen backgrounds, paraphrased instructions, and their mixture. For a fair comparison, the agent operates under the same observation protocol as post-trained policies, receiving only RGB camera images and proprioceptive robot states without depth, camera calibration, or simulator ground truth. For each task, the agent receives a task description annotated by GPT-6-Astra from a single training episode as single-shot in-context learning (ICL). Across all 510 test episodes, we evaluate both direct control and a harness with policy invoking either the VLA π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} or the WAM InternW0- Δ \Delta , compare each configuration against the post-trained policies on the EBench leaderboard, and analyze execution trajectories across paired episodes.
paragraphs.zh: 为了进一步探究这些问题，我们将 GPT-6-Astra 作为智能体的核心在 EBench （Gao et al., 2026）上进行评估。 该诊断性操作基准按移动性、操作精度和任务跨度对任务进行分类，并在未见物体、未见背景、改述指令及其混合这些泛化维度上评估鲁棒性。 为了公平比较，智能体在与后训练策略相同的观测协议下运行，仅接收 RGB 相机图像和本体感知的机器人状态，而不使用深度信息、相机标定或模拟器真值。 对于每个任务，智能体会接收由 GPT-6-Astra 从单个训练回合中标注的任务描述，作为单次上下文学习（ICL）。 在全部 510 个测试回合中，我们同时评估直接控制和使用策略调用 VLA π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 或 WAM InternW0- Δ \Delta 的执行框架，将每种配置与 EBench 排行榜上的后训练策略进行比较，并分析成对回合中的执行轨迹。

paragraphs.en: Under direct control, the GPT-6-Astra-based agent achieves a 46.7% overall success rate and a 0.654 stage-completion score, outperforming post-trained policies such as Qwen-RobotManip and π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} trained on 6,600 in-domain demonstrations. Among the compared post-trained policies, the agent ranks first on short-horizon tasks with a 73.2% success rate, shows the smallest success-rate variation across the four generalization dimensions, and completes a novel composite instruction zero-shot on which both compared post-trained policies fail. Conversely, its success rate drops to 27.3% on long-horizon tasks, 20.0% on tabletop manipulation, and 11.3% on high-precision contact-rich tasks. Trajectory analysis shows that while the agent performs well at visual grounding and in-episode error recovery, its physical execution is limited by long action chunks between observations and by contact geometry that it must infer explicitly from RGB views.

paragraphs.en: Invoking a post-trained policy through the agent harness increases the overall success rate to 53.0% with π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} and 56.0% with InternW0- Δ \Delta and reduces the agent’s token cost per success by more than half. With InternW0- Δ \Delta , the harness surpasses all post-trained policies compared in Table 1 . The harness with policy retains the agent’s high success rate on short-horizon tasks and improves performance on long-horizon and bimanual tasks where the post-trained policy is competent. At the same time, case analysis identifies two limitations of the current harness with policy. First, neither component resolves high-precision contact-rich manipulation. Second, agent and policy coordinate loosely in three respects: the agent invokes the policy for most execution steps even on tasks where that policy alone rarely succeeds, the policy follows the fixed task instruction instead of the agent’s subgoal, and the agent often leaves a held grasp unmaintained when it resumes control after a policy invocation, which makes object drops more frequent.
paragraphs.zh: 通过智能体框架调用后训练策略，将整体成功率提升至 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 的 53.0% 和 InternW0- Δ \Delta 的 56.0%，并将智能体每次成功的 token 成本降低了一半以上。 使用 InternW0- Δ \Delta 时，该框架超越了表 1 中对比的所有后训练策略。 该框架结合策略后，在短时程任务上保持了智能体的高成功率，并在后训练策略具备能力且涉及长时程和双臂操作的任务上提升了性能。 与此同时，案例分析指出了当前框架结合策略的两个局限性。 首先，无论哪个组件都无法解决高精度的接触丰富型操作问题。 其次，智能体与策略在三个方面协调松散：即使在仅靠该策略很少成功的任务上，智能体也会在大多数执行步骤中调用该策略；策略遵循固定的任务指令而非智能体的子目标；此外，在策略调用结束后智能体恢复控制时，往往不会维持已持有的抓取状态，这使得物体掉落更加频繁。

paragraphs.en: The main contributions of this report are as follows:
paragraphs.zh: 本报告的主要贡献如下：

paragraphs.en: Paired evaluation across agent configurations and post-trained policies. Under the same observation protocol as post-trained policies, we evaluate an GPT-6-Astra-based agent under direct control and in a harness with policy across all 510 EBench test episodes. We compare both agent configurations against standalone post-trained VLA and WAM policies across all task groups and generalization dimensions.
paragraphs.zh: 跨智能体配置与后训练策略的成对评估。 在与后训练策略相同的观测协议下，我们在全部 510 个 EBench 测试回合中，评估了基于 GPT-6-Astra 的智能体在直接控制以及搭载策略的执行框架下的表现。 我们在所有任务组和泛化维度上，将两种智能体配置与独立的后训练 VLA 和 WAM 策略进行比较。

sents.en: Paired evaluation across agent configurations and post-trained policies.
sents.zh: 跨智能体配置与后训练策略的成对评估。

sents.en: Under the same observation protocol as post-trained policies, we evaluate an GPT-6-Astra-based agent under direct control and in a harness with policy across all 510 EBench test episodes.
sents.zh: 在与后训练策略相同的观测协议下，我们在全部 510 个 EBench 测试回合中，评估了基于 GPT-6-Astra 的智能体在直接控制以及搭载策略的执行框架下的表现。

sents.en: We compare both agent configurations against standalone post-trained VLA and WAM policies across all task groups and generalization dimensions.
sents.zh: 我们在所有任务组和泛化维度上，将两种智能体配置与独立的后训练 VLA 和 WAM 策略进行比较。

paragraphs.en: Characterization of agent capabilities under direct control. We locate where the GPT-6-Astra-based agent leads or trails eight post-trained policies while using only a single annotated task demonstration and no parameter updates, trace its unsuccessful episodes to their failure mechanisms, and examine its in-episode adaptation, the safety of its execution, and its zero-shot composition of skills on a novel instruction. Together, these analyses show where the agent and the policies complement each other.
paragraphs.zh: 在直接控制下对智能体能力的刻画。 我们定位了基于 GPT-6-Astra 的智能体在仅使用单个带标注的任务演示且不进行参数更新的情况下，相对于八个经训练后策略的领先与落后之处，将其失败的片段追溯至相应的失败机制，并考察其在片段内的自适应能力、执行的安全性，以及在新指令上零样本组合技能的表现。 综合来看，这些分析表明了该智能体与这些策略在哪些方面能够互为补充。

sents.en: Characterization of agent capabilities under direct control.
sents.zh: 在直接控制下对智能体能力的刻画。

paragraphs.en: Analysis of harness with policy and implications for agent harness design. We evaluate the harness with either policy against each of its components on every task, trace the episodes that newly fail under the harness and those that fail with both policies to their decisive incidents, and analyze the agent’s policy invocation and the resulting token cost. These analyses locate the remaining gap to the better component in policy invocation, subgoal passing, and grasp maintenance when the agent resumes control, which informs the design of future agent harnesses.
paragraphs.zh: 对结合策略的执行框架的分析及其对智能体执行框架设计的启示。 我们在每项任务上评估带任一策略的执行框架与其各个组件的对比，追踪在该框架下新出现失败的回合以及两种策略下均失败的回合直至其决定性事件，并分析智能体的策略调用及由此产生的 token 成本。 这些分析将智能体与更优组件之间的剩余差距定位于策略调用、子目标传递以及智能体恢复控制时的抓取维持，这为未来智能体执行框架的设计提供了参考。

sents.en: Analysis of harness with policy and implications for agent harness design.
sents.zh: 对结合策略的执行框架的分析及其对智能体执行框架设计的启示。

paragraphs.en: Two lines of work apply foundation models to robot manipulation. Post-trained policies typically adapt foundation models on robot manipulation trajectories, including VLA models that fine-tune vision-language backbones for action prediction ( Kim et al., 2025 ; Black et al., 2025b ; Black et al., 2025a ) and WAMs that jointly model future visual dynamics and actions ( Ye et al., 2026 ; Kim et al., 2026 ; Yuan et al., 2026b ; Miao et al., 2026 ) . Direct control with frontier MLLMs , in contrast, uses frontier MLLMs as the cores of agents that control robots without parameter updates. Early approaches translate model predictions into robot motion through generated programs that call perception and control APIs ( Liang et al., 2023 ) or through embodiment-specific semantic primitives ( Chen et al., 2026 ) , whereas more recent studies prompt MLLMs to output EEF or joint commands directly ( Jia et al., 2026 ; Lou et al., 2026 ) . On the RoboDojo benchmark, for example, GPT-6-Astra generates robot actions directly from observations ( Zhang et al., 2026a ) , and providing in-context demonstration segments together with in-episode interaction history further improves task success ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Cai et al., 2026b ) . Rather than evaluating direct control in isolation, our work systematically compares GPT-6-Astra under direct control against post-trained VLA and WAM policies on EBench ( Gao et al., 2026 ) by task group and generalization dimension, linking dimension-level performance to step-by-step execution trajectories.
paragraphs.zh: 有两条研究线路将基础模型应用于机器人操作。 后训练策略通常在机器人操作轨迹上对基础模型进行适配，包括针对动作预测微调视觉-语言骨干的VLA模型（ Kim et al., 2025 ; Black et al., 2025b ; Black et al., 2025a ），以及联合建模未来视觉动态与动作的WAM（ Ye et al., 2026 ; Kim et al., 2026 ; Yuan et al., 2026b ; Miao et al., 2026 ）。 与之相对，由前沿MLLM直接进行控制的方式，是将前沿MLLM作为智能体的核心来控制机器人，而不进行参数更新。 早期方法通过生成的调用感知与控制API的程序（ Liang et al., 2023 ），或通过特定本体（具身形态）的语义原语（ Chen et al., 2026 ）将模型预测转化为机器人运动，而较新的研究则提示MLLM直接输出末端执行器（EEF）或关节命令（ Jia et al., 2026 ; Lou et al., 2026 ）。 例如在RoboDojo基准上，GPT-6-Astra直接从观测生成机器人动作（ Zhang et al., 2026a ），而提供上下文内演示片段连同回合内交互历史可进一步提升任务成功率（ Liu et al., 2026 ; Cai et al., 2026b ）。 我们的工作不是孤立地评估直接控制，而是在EBench（ Gao et al., 2026 ）上按任务组和泛化维度，系统性地比较直接控制下的GPT-6-Astra与后训练的VLA和WAM策略，并将维度层面的表现与逐步执行轨迹联系起来。

paragraphs.en: Combining both lines, recent frameworks build hierarchical harnesses in which an agent with an MLLM core invokes post-trained policies for action execution ( Qin et al., 2026 ; Cai et al., 2026b ) . For instance, Harness VLA invokes a frozen VLA alongside scripted or analytical primitives ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) , BATON coordinates long-horizon VLA execution through a transition-aware memory that verifies subtask entry and exit conditions ( Xu et al., 2026 ) , and HarnessPAI synthesizes task-specific control programs that invoke post-trained policies without online deliberation ( Wang et al., 2026a ) . Related frameworks also adapt harness coordination logic, policy interfaces, or recovery tools during deployment ( Tang et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026c ; Ding et al., 2026 ) . However, existing studies primarily evaluate each proposed harness as a single integrated system. In contrast, we evaluate the agent both under direct control and in a harness with policy, and compare both agent configurations against standalone VLA and WAM policies across the same test scenes under a fixed in-context protocol. This paired evaluation quantifies how the agent’s policy invocation decisions align with the standalone competence of the post-trained policy, and traces episode-level gains and losses to the agent’s direct control, policy execution, or the transitions between them.
paragraphs.zh: 结合这两条路线，近期框架构建了分层架构（harness），其中以多模态大模型为核心、调用经后训练策略执行动作（Qin et al., 2026; Cai et al., 2026b）。 例如，Harness VLA 调用冻结的 VLA 以及脚本化或解析式原语（Zhang et al., 2026b）；BATON 通过验证子任务进入与退出条件的迁移感知记忆来协调长时程 VLA 执行（Xu et al., 2026）；HarnessPAI 则合成任务特定的控制程序，调用经后训练策略而无需在线推理（Wang et al., 2026a）。 相关框架还在部署过程中调整 harness 的协调逻辑、策略接口或恢复工具（Tang et al., 2026; Li et al., 2026c; Ding et al., 2026）。 然而，现有研究主要将每个提出的 harness 作为一个单一集成系统进行评估。 相比之下，我们既在直接控制下评估智能体，也在带有策略的 harness 中评估智能体，并在固定的上下文协议下，将这两种智能体配置与独立的 VLA 和 WAM 策略在同一组测试场景中进行比较。 这种成对评估量化了智能体的策略调用决策与经后训练策略的独立能力之间的对齐程度，并将回合层面的得失追溯至智能体的直接控制、策略执行或二者之间的切换过程。

sents.zh: 例如，Harness VLA 调用冻结的 VLA 以及脚本化或解析式原语（Zhang et al., 2026b）；BATON 通过验证子任务进入与退出条件的迁移感知记忆来协调长时程 VLA 执行（Xu et al., 2026）；HarnessPAI 则合成任务特定的控制程序，调用经后训练策略而无需在线推理（Wang et al., 2026a）。

sents.en: Related frameworks also adapt harness coordination logic, policy interfaces, or recovery tools during deployment ( Tang et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026c ; Ding et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 相关框架还在部署过程中调整 harness 的协调逻辑、策略接口或恢复工具（Tang et al., 2026; Li et al., 2026c; Ding et al., 2026）。

sents.en: However, existing studies primarily evaluate each proposed harness as a single integrated system.
sents.zh: 然而，现有研究主要将每个提出的 harness 作为一个单一集成系统进行评估。

sents.en: In contrast, we evaluate the agent both under direct control and in a harness with policy, and compare both agent configurations against standalone VLA and WAM policies across the same test scenes under a fixed in-context protocol.
sents.zh: 相比之下，我们既在直接控制下评估智能体，也在带有策略的 harness 中评估智能体，并在固定的上下文协议下，将这两种智能体配置与独立的 VLA 和 WAM 策略在同一组测试场景中进行比较。

sents.en: This paired evaluation quantifies how the agent’s policy invocation decisions align with the standalone competence of the post-trained policy, and traces episode-level gains and losses to the agent’s direct control, policy execution, or the transitions between them.
sents.zh: 这种成对评估量化了智能体的策略调用决策与经后训练策略的独立能力之间的对齐程度，并将回合层面的得失追溯至智能体的直接控制、策略执行或二者之间的切换过程。

paragraphs.en: To compare a frontier MLLM with post-trained policies on a common benchmark, we first define the agent and its harness, and then specify the two agent configurations evaluated in this study: direct control and harness with policy.

paragraphs.en: The two agent configurations evaluated in this study share the observation interface 𝒪 H \mathcal{O}_{H} and differ in the tool calls 𝒜 H \mathcal{A}_{H} exposed by the agent harness. Under direct control , 𝒜 H act = 𝒜 EEF \mathcal{A}_{H}^{\mathrm{act}}=\mathcal{A}_{\mathrm{EEF}} , which consists of EEF, base, and gripper commands, and 𝒜 H info \mathcal{A}_{H}^{\mathrm{info}} contains only a call that returns the current views and robot state, so the agent generates all motion commands itself. Under harness with policy , following Harness VLA ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) , the harness expands the action set to 𝒜 H act = 𝒜 EEF ∪ 𝒜 pol \mathcal{A}_{H}^{\mathrm{act}}=\mathcal{A}_{\mathrm{EEF}}\cup\mathcal{A}_{\mathrm{pol}} , where 𝒜 pol \mathcal{A}_{\mathrm{pol}} denotes invocations of a post-trained policy, and adds to 𝒜 H info \mathcal{A}_{H}^{\mathrm{info}} a call that returns the annotated task demonstration on request. In each policy invocation, the agent specifies a step limit within which the post-trained policy executes autonomously under the fixed task instruction before returning an updated observation through 𝒪 H \mathcal{O}_{H} . In this configuration, the agent alternates between issuing direct waypoint commands and invoking the post-trained policy for closed-loop trajectory execution, while retaining task planning, progress monitoring, and error recovery. Section 5 characterizes the capability boundary under direct control, and Section 6 evaluates how the harness with policy affects performance across capability dimensions.

paragraphs.en: EBench ( Gao et al., 2026 ) is a diagnostic simulation benchmark for generalist robot manipulation, built on GenManip ( Gao et al., 2025 ) and Isaac Sim with the ARX Lift 2 dual-arm mobile robot. Its 26 tasks span 9 scene categories across household, retail, and industrial settings, testing functional contexts such as food preparation, household cleaning, retail checkout, and component assembly. Completing these tasks requires relating object functions and spatial layouts to the task goal and sequencing the necessary manipulation steps. EBench annotates each task along five capability dimensions: scene, atomic skill, operating mode, manipulation precision, and task horizon. Our analyses mainly group tasks by the last three, and Appendix C.2 reports the results of Section 6 by atomic skill. Operating mode, which we refer to as mobility, separates 19 mobile from 7 tabletop tasks, manipulation precision separates 14 low-, 8 medium-, and 4 high-precision tasks, and task horizon separates 11 short- from 15 long-horizon tasks. The 510 test episodes span four generalization dimensions: Background with unseen backgrounds, Object with unseen object instances, Instruction with paraphrased instructions, and Mix with their joint perturbation.
paragraphs.zh: EBench（Gao 等，2026）是一个面向通用机器人操作的诊断式仿真基准，构建于 GenManip（Gao 等，2025）与 Isaac Sim 之上，使用 ARX Lift 2 双臂移动机器人。 其 26 个任务涵盖家庭、零售和工业场景中的 9 类场景类别，测试食物准备、家庭清洁、零售结算和零部件装配等功能性情境。 完成这些任务需要将物体功能与空间布局关联到任务目标，并对必要的操作步骤进行排序。 EBench 沿五个能力维度对每个任务进行标注：场景、原子技能、操作模式、操作精度和任务时域。 我们的分析主要按后三个维度对任务分组，附录 C.2 按原子技能报告第 6 节的结果。 操作模式（我们称之为移动性）将 19 个移动任务与 7 个桌面任务区分开来，操作精度区分了 14 个低精度、8 个中精度和 4 个高精度任务，任务时域区分了 11 个短时域任务和 15 个长时域任务。 510 个测试回合涵盖四个泛化维度：Background（未见过的背景）、Object（未见过的物体实例）、Instruction（改写后的指令）以及 Mix（上述扰动的联合作用）。

paragraphs.en: The evaluation covers all 26 test tasks across 510 episodes, with 20 episodes for each of 24 tasks and 15 each for Sandwich and Microwave, spanning 468 distinct scenes. Performance is evaluated using two official metrics: task success rate (SR) and stage-completion score, which assigns partial credit for intermediate stages completed by the end of an episode according to task-specific rules. Both metrics are first averaged across episodes within each task and then averaged equally across all 26 tasks. Each episode is bounded by a task-specific physics-step limit ranging from 1,500 to 5,000 steps at 30 Hz, which is not disclosed to the agent.
paragraphs.zh: 评估涵盖全部 26 个测试任务共 510 个回合，其中 24 个任务各 20 个回合，Sandwich 和 Microwave 各 15 个回合，跨越 468 个不同场景。 性能采用两项官方指标进行评估：任务成功率（SR）和阶段完成得分，后者根据任务特定规则，对回合结束时已完成的中间阶段给予部分得分。 两项指标先在每个任务内对回合取平均，然后对所有 26 个任务等权取平均。 每个回合受限于一个任务特定的物理步数上限，范围从 30 Hz 下的 1,500 到 5,000 步，该上限不会透露给智能体。

sents.en: Performance is evaluated using two official metrics: task success rate (SR) and stage-completion score, which assigns partial credit for intermediate stages completed by the end of an episode according to task-specific rules.

paragraphs.en: We use GPT-6-Astra ( OpenAI, 2026 ) with high reasoning effort as the core of the agent and initiate an independent session thread for each episode. At each decision step, based on the current visual and proprioceptive observations, the agent outputs one or more EEF and base waypoints, including target gripper states and execution durations. Meanwhile, the agent provides a brief text explaining the rationale for the command, which we refer to as its stated reason . These waypoints are interpolated into an action chunk and executed in the simulator, after which the updated observations are returned. The shared task prompt includes empirical operational routines, such as grasp verification: closing the gripper while stationary, lifting by 1 cm, and confirming that the object moves with the gripper, as detailed in Appendix A . Token usage, tool calls, and inference time are unconstrained. If the agent terminates an episode before the physics-step limit, the robot holds its final pose until the evaluation server computes the official SR and score.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 GPT-6-Astra（ OpenAI, 2026 ）并设置高推理强度作为智能体的核心，并为每个回合启动独立的会话线程。 在每个决策步骤，智能体基于当前的视觉与本体感觉观测，输出一个或多个末端执行器（EEF）与底盘路径点，包括目标夹爪状态和执行时长。 同时，智能体会提供一段简短的文字来解释该指令的理由，我们将其称为其陈述理由。 这些路径点被插值成动作块并在仿真器中执行，随后返回更新后的观测。 共享的任务提示包含经验性操作规程，例如抓取验证：在静止状态下闭合夹爪、抬升 1 厘米，并确认物体随夹爪一起移动，详见附录 A 。 Token 用量、工具调用和推理时间均不受限制。 如果智能体在物理步数上限之前终止了某个回合，机器人将保持其最终姿态，直到评估服务器计算出官方 SR 与分数。

sents.zh: 如果智能体在物理步数上限之前终止了某个回合，机器人将保持其最终姿态，直到评估服务器计算出官方 SR 与分数。

paragraphs.en: Across both direct control and the harness with policy, the agent is evaluated under the same observation protocol as post-trained policies, receiving only RGB camera observations and proprioceptive robot states through pre-defined tools. Specifically, the interface supplies the views of three RGB cameras: the overview camera, termed overlook in the prompts, and the left and right wrist cameras. All three views are provided at the first step and can be requested selectively thereafter, together with the proprioceptive state comprising both EEF poses, gripper widths, the mobile base pose, and elapsed simulator steps. It provides no depth maps, camera calibration parameters, ground-truth object poses, segmentation masks, intermediate reward signals, subgoal indicators, or remaining step budgets. Official SR and score values are computed only after an episode terminates, and no state or experience is retained across episodes.
paragraphs.zh: 在直接控制和使用策略框架（harness）这两种方式下，智能体均采用与后训练策略相同的观测协议进行评估，仅通过预定义的工具接收 RGB 相机观测和机器人本体感知状态。 具体而言，该接口提供三个 RGB 相机的视图：一个总览相机（在提示词中称为 overlook），以及左、右腕部相机。 三个视图在第一步全部提供，此后可以有选择地按需请求，同时可获取包含两个末端执行器（EEF）位姿、夹爪开度、移动底盘位姿以及已用仿真步数的本体感知状态。 它不提供深度图、相机标定参数、物体真实位姿、分割掩码、中间奖励信号、子目标指示或剩余步数预算。 官方的成功率（SR）和分数仅在回合结束后计算，且任何状态或经验都不会在回合之间保留。

paragraphs.en: Each task is accompanied by a detailed task description derived from a single demonstration in the EBench training set as single-shot ICL. Specifically, prior to evaluation, a separate GPT-6-Astra instance with high reasoning effort inspects one training trajectory, selects 10–18 keyframes, summarizes the operation sequence, and pairs the selected keyframes with the recorded robot states and actions, as shown in Appendix A.3 . During evaluation, the agent is instructed to adapt the demonstrated procedure and spatial relations to current visual observations rather than replaying recorded coordinates.
paragraphs.zh: 每个任务都附带一份详细的任务描述，该描述源自 EBench 训练集中的单条演示，作为单次（single-shot）上下文学习（ICL）。 具体而言，在评估之前，一个采用高推理强度的独立 GPT-6-Astra 实例会检查一条训练轨迹，选取 10–18 个关键帧，总结操作序列，并将选出的关键帧与记录的机器人状态和动作配对，如附录 A.3 所示。 在评估过程中，智能体被要求根据当前的视觉观察结果对演示的操作步骤和空间关系进行调整，而不是照搬记录的坐标。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the GPT-6-Astra-based agent under two agent configurations, direct control and harness with policy instantiated with either π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} or InternW0- Δ \Delta , as illustrated in Figure 1 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在两种智能体配置下评估基于 GPT-6-Astra 的智能体：直接控制（direct control）和策略由 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 或 InternW0- Δ \Delta 实例化的 harness 配置，如图 1 所示。

paragraphs.en: The agent harness exposes only the EEF waypoint interface described above, and the agent invokes no external policy. This configuration isolates the standalone manipulation capability of the MLLM core.
paragraphs.zh: 该智能体框架仅暴露上述的末端执行器（EEF）路径点接口，且智能体不调用任何外部策略。 该配置用于隔离评测 MLLM 核心独立的操作能力。

sents.en: The agent harness exposes only the EEF waypoint interface described above, and the agent invokes no external policy.
sents.zh: 该智能体框架仅暴露上述的末端执行器（EEF）路径点接口，且智能体不调用任何外部策略。

sents.en: This configuration isolates the standalone manipulation capability of the MLLM core.
sents.zh: 该配置用于隔离评测 MLLM 核心独立的操作能力。

paragraphs.en: In this configuration, the agent retains the EEF waypoint interface and can additionally invoke one of two frozen post-trained policies as a tool: the official leaderboard checkpoint of the VLA π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} ( Black et al., 2025a ) or the WAM InternW0- Δ \Delta ( Miao et al., 2026 ) , both post-trained on EBench demonstrations. For each policy invocation, the agent specifies a step limit of 1–300 physics steps together with a stated reason. Within this step limit, the post-trained policy executes autonomously under the fixed task instruction, after which the updated visual and proprioceptive observations are returned to the agent. The harness also lets the agent query the annotated task demonstration again at any point. At each decision step, the agent chooses between issuing direct EEF waypoints and invoking the post-trained policy. In other words, the agent controls when and for how many steps the policy executes, but cannot pass agent-modified task prompts to the underlying policy, as discussed in Section 6.5 .
paragraphs.zh: 在此配置中，智能体保留末端执行器（EEF）航点接口，并可以额外调用两个冻结的后训练策略之一作为工具：VLA π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 的官方排行榜检查点（Black et al., 2025a）或 WAM InternW0- Δ \Delta（Miao et al., 2026），两者均在 EBench 演示数据上进行了后训练。 对于每次策略调用，智能体需指定 1–300 个物理步的步数上限，并说明理由。 在该步数上限内，后训练策略在固定任务指令下自主执行，执行完毕后，更新后的视觉与本体感觉观测将返回给智能体。 该框架还允许智能体在任意时刻重新查询带注释的任务演示。 在每个决策步，智能体可以选择直接发出 EEF 航点或调用后训练策略。 换言之，智能体控制策略何时执行以及执行多少步，但无法将智能体修改过的任务提示传递给底层策略，如第 6.5 节所讨论的那样。

paragraphs.en: We compare the GPT-6-Astra-based agent under direct control and in the harness with π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} or InternW0- Δ \Delta against the post-trained VLA and WAM policies on the EBench leaderboard, as summarized in Table 1 . Dimension-level and per-task analyses in Section 5 compare the agent against eight post-trained policies with per-task results on the 510 test episodes: OpenWAM- α \alpha ( Wang et al., 2026b ) , InternW0- Δ \Delta ( Miao et al., 2026 ) , Qwen-RobotManip ( Yuan et al., 2026a ) , π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} ( Black et al., 2025a ) , InternVLA-A1.5 ( Ma et al., 2026a ) , π 0 \pi_{0} ( Black et al., 2025b ) , GigaBrain-0.7 ( GigaBrain Team et al., 2026 ) , and Fast-WAM ( Yuan et al., 2026b ) , all post-trained on the public EBench training set of 6,600 episodes across the 26 tasks. All comparisons across configurations of the agent are paired by test episode, with statistical procedures detailed in Appendix B.3 .

paragraphs.en: This section evaluates the GPT-6-Astra-based agent under direct control, in which the harness exposes observations and EEF waypoint commands but no post-trained policy. Every motion of the robot is therefore commanded by GPT-6-Astra itself, so the results isolate the manipulation capabilities of the MLLM. We first compare overall performance, task groups, and generalization dimensions with those of the eight post-trained policies, and then trace the failure patterns of unsuccessful episodes, the agent’s adaptation within an episode, and the safety risks of its execution. Through case studies and a pilot experiment, we further examine the role of the in-context demonstration and zero-shot compositional generalization, and finally summarize the resulting capability boundary.
paragraphs.zh: 本节评估基于 GPT-6-Astra 的智能体在直接控制下的表现，其中运行框架只提供观测和末端执行器（EEF）路径点指令，而不使用后训练策略。 因此机器人的每一个动作都由 GPT-6-Astra 本身发出指令，从而这些结果可以单独反映多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的操作能力。 我们首先在总体性能、任务组和泛化维度上与八个后训练策略进行比较，然后追踪失败回合的失败模式、智能体在回合内的适应情况，以及其执行过程中的安全风险。 通过案例研究和一项初步实验，我们进一步考察上下文内示例的作用和零样本组合泛化能力，最后总结由此得到的能力边界。

sents.en: Every motion of the robot is therefore commanded by GPT-6-Astra itself, so the results isolate the manipulation capabilities of the MLLM.

sents.en: We first compare overall performance, task groups, and generalization dimensions with those of the eight post-trained policies, and then trace the failure patterns of unsuccessful episodes, the agent’s adaptation within an episode, and the safety risks of its execution.
sents.zh: 我们首先在总体性能、任务组和泛化维度上与八个后训练策略进行比较，然后追踪失败回合的失败模式、智能体在回合内的适应情况，以及其执行过程中的安全风险。

sents.en: Through case studies and a pilot experiment, we further examine the role of the in-context demonstration and zero-shot compositional generalization, and finally summarize the resulting capability boundary.
sents.zh: 通过案例研究和一项初步实验，我们进一步考察上下文内示例的作用和零样本组合泛化能力，最后总结由此得到的能力边界。

paragraphs.en: The GPT-6-Astra-based agent under direct control receives a single annotated demonstration per task and no parameter updates, yet it is competitive with VLA and WAM policies post-trained on 6,600 demonstrations of the same tasks. Compared with the eight post-trained policies in Table 1 , the direct-control agent ranks third on both metrics with 46.7% SR and a 0.654 score. It trails only two WAMs, as OpenWAM- α \alpha reaches 55.3% SR and a 0.701 score and InternW0- Δ \Delta reaches 49.2% SR and a 0.660 score. It outperforms the remaining six policies, including the VLAs Qwen-RobotManip with 45.6% SR and a 0.608 score and π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} with 41.4% SR and a 0.544 score. Appendix Tables B.2 and B.3 report the per-task SR and score.
paragraphs.zh: 基于GPT-6-Astra、受直接控制的智能体在每个任务中只接收单个带注释的示范且不进行任何参数更新，却能与在相同任务的6,600个示范上经过后训练的VLA和WAM策略相竞争。 与表1中的八个后训练策略相比，该直接控制智能体在两项指标上均排名第三，SR为46.7%，得分为0.654。 它仅落后于两个WAM，因为OpenWAM- α \alpha 的SR达到55.3%，得分为0.701，InternW0- Δ \Delta 的SR达到49.2%，得分为0.660。 它优于其余六个策略，包括SR为45.6%、得分为0.608的VLA Qwen-RobotManip，以及SR为41.4%、得分为0.544的π 0.5 \pi_{0.5}。 附录表B.2和B.3报告了每个任务的SR和得分。

paragraphs.en: The gap between score and SR shows that the direct-control agent frequently earns stage credit in episodes that it does not finish. SR counts only complete successes, whereas the score also credits the stages completed before an unsuccessful episode ends. The SR of the direct-control agent trails that of InternW0- Δ \Delta by 2.5 percentage points and exceeds that of Qwen-RobotManip by only 1.1 points, whereas its score nearly matches that of InternW0- Δ \Delta and clearly exceeds those of Qwen-RobotManip and π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} . More generally, its score exceeds its SR by a larger margin than that of any post-trained policy. Section 5.2 therefore first uses Figure 2 to locate where the agent leads and trails, and Section 5.3 then examines the stages at which its episodes fail.
paragraphs.zh: 分数与SR之间的差距表明，直接控制智能体经常在它未能完成回合中获得阶段得分。 SR只统计完整成功的次数，而分数也会为不成功回合结束前已完成的阶段记分。 直接控制智能体的SR比InternW0- Δ \Delta低2.5个百分点，仅比Qwen-RobotManip高1.1个百分点，而其分数与InternW0- Δ \Delta几乎持平，并明显超过Qwen-RobotManip和π 0.5 \pi_{0.5}的分数。 更普遍地说，其分数超过其SR的幅度大于任何经过后训练的策略。 因此，第5.2节首先使用图2定位该智能体领先与落后的地方，第5.3节随后检查其回合在哪些阶段失败。

paragraphs.en: Across task groups, the performance of the direct-control agent splits by the type of demand rather than declining uniformly with task difficulty, as shown in Figures 2 a and 3 a and Appendix Figure B.2 . It ranks first on short-horizon tasks and second on mobile and low-precision tasks, where only OpenWAM- α \alpha leads it. It drops to seventh on long-horizon and tabletop tasks and to eighth on high-precision tasks. The following paragraphs profile the agent along the horizon, mobility, and precision of the tasks and along the generalization dimensions, and Section 5.3 traces the failures behind the trailing ranks to their mechanisms.
paragraphs.zh: 如如图2a、图3a以及附录图B.2所示，在各任务组之间，直接控制智能体的表现按需求类型分化，而非随任务难度统一下降。 它在短时程任务上排名第一，在移动性和低精度任务上排名第二，在这些任务上只有 OpenWAM-α 领先于它。 它在长时程任务和桌面任务上降至第七名，在高精度任务上降至第八名。 以下段落从任务时程、移动性和精度以及泛化维度对该智能体进行剖析，第5.3节则将排名靠后的失败追溯到其机制层面。

paragraphs.en: The horizon of a task separates the agent’s strongest group from one of its weakest. On the 11 short-horizon tasks, it achieves the highest SR of 73.2% and score of 0.766, surpassing all eight post-trained policies including OpenWAM- α \alpha at 65.9% SR and a 0.700 score. Eight of these 11 tasks require only low precision, and most of them consist of locating an object and its target, repositioning the base, and carrying the object between them, which the agent plans from its current views and executes with base and EEF waypoints. When a task reduces to such coarse transport between located targets, a single annotated demonstration and the priors of the MLLM therefore suffice for the agent to exceed policies post-trained on the full training set across this group. On the 15 long-horizon tasks, by contrast, the agent reaches only 27.3% SR, whereas OpenWAM- α \alpha reaches 47.6%. On these tasks, the agent often completes the early stages but not the full task. On Detergent, for example, it reaches a mean score of 0.80 but completes the full task in only 55% of episodes.
paragraphs.zh: 任务的时间跨度将智能体最强的任务组与最弱的任务组之一区分开来。 在11个短时间跨度任务上，它取得了最高的73.2%成功率和0.766的分数，超越了包括成功率为65.9%、分数为0.700的OpenWAM-α在内的全部八个后训练策略。 这11个任务中有八个只需低精度，且其中大多数由定位物体及其目标、重新调整底盘位置、以及在两者之间搬运物体组成，智能体根据当前视角进行规划，并以底盘和末端执行器的路径点执行。 当任务简化为在已定位的目标之间进行这种粗粒度搬运时，单条标注演示加上MLLM的先验知识就足以让智能体在该任务组上超越在完整训练集上后训练的策略。 相比之下，在15个长时间跨度任务上，智能体仅达到27.3%的成功率，而OpenWAM-α达到47.6%。 在这些任务上，智能体往往能完成早期阶段，却无法完成整个任务。 例如，在Detergent任务上，它的平均分数达到0.80，但仅在55%的回合中完成整个任务。

sents.zh: 任务的时间跨度将智能体最强的任务组与最弱的任务组之一区分开来。

paragraphs.en: The mobility groups order task difficulty differently for the agent than for several post-trained policies. Because 10 of the 11 short-horizon tasks are mobile, the agent ranks second on the 19 mobile tasks with 56.6% SR. On the seven tabletop tasks, its SR falls to 20.0%, whereas Qwen-RobotManip reaches 50.0%. Qwen-RobotManip and GigaBrain-0.7, by contrast, achieve a higher SR on tabletop tasks than on mobile tasks. The tabletop gap extends beyond the four high-precision tabletop tasks to the other three: Frame, Flip cup & cookies, and Glass into box. On these three tasks, the agent reaches a mean SR of 31.7%, whereas Qwen-RobotManip reaches 91.7%. On the mobile tasks, in turn, the agent’s leading results rest on visual grounding. The Bookmark task requires locating a thin, flat bookmark on a desk crowded with visually similar stationery and everyday objects and placing it onto an open book. The agent succeeds in 90% of these episodes, whereas π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} reaches 55% and the remaining seven post-trained policies reach 25%–45%. In the Teacup & teapot task, the agent has to tell the two objects apart and place the teacup on the saucer and the teapot on the tray. It reaches 85% SR and a 0.93 score, whereas InternW0- Δ \Delta and Qwen-RobotManip lead the post-trained policies with 45% SR. In the Remote task, the agent must place the remote into a designated compartment of a divided holder. It succeeds in every episode, whereas InternW0- Δ \Delta succeeds in 85%. Perfume also targets a compartment of a divided organizer, and on this task the agent ties OpenWAM- α \alpha for the highest SR at 75% with a higher score of 0.88 against 0.78. Bookmark, Teacup & teapot, and Remote are the three tasks on which the agent leads all eight post-trained policies. These three tasks and Perfume all require locating the specified object among distractors or the specified compartment among several before placing the object there. These leads therefore indicate that the agent grounds objects and targets reliably, as Appendix Figure D.1 illustrates for Bookmark and Remote from the grasp approach to the placement.
paragraphs.zh: 移动类任务组对任务难度的排序对该智能体与对多个后训练策略而言是不同的。 由于 11 个短时程任务中有 10 个是移动类任务，该智能体在 19 个移动类任务上以 56.6% 的成功率排名第二。 在七个桌面任务上，其成功率降至 20.0%，而 Qwen-RobotManip 达到 50.0%。 相比之下，Qwen-RobotManip 和 GigaBrain-0.7 在桌面任务上的成功率高于在移动类任务上的成功率。 桌面任务的差距不仅限于四个高精度桌面任务，还延伸到另外三个任务：Frame、Flip cup & cookies 和 Glass into box。 在这三个任务上，该智能体的平均成功率为 31.7%，而 Qwen-RobotManip 达到 91.7%。 反过来，该智能体在移动类任务上的领先结果则依赖于视觉定位能力。 Bookmark 任务要求在一张摆满外观相似的文具和日常用品的桌子上找到一枚薄而扁平的书签，并将其放到一本打开的书上。 该智能体在这些回合中的成功率为 90%，而 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 达到 55%，其余七个后训练策略为 25%–45%。 在 Teacup & teapot 任务中，该智能体必须区分这两个物体，并把茶杯放到茶托上、把茶壶放到托盘上。 它达到 85% 的成功率和 0.93 的分数，而 InternW0- Δ \Delta 和 Qwen-RobotManip 以 45% 的成功率领先于各后训练策略。 在 Remote 任务中，该智能体必须把遥控器放入一个分格收纳装置的指定格子里。 它在所有回合中都成功了，而 InternW0- Δ \Delta 的成功率为 85%。 Perfume 任务同样要瞄准一个分格收纳装置的格子，在该任务上，该智能体与 OpenWAM- α \alpha 并列最高成功率 75%，但分数更高，为 0.88 对 0.78。 Bookmark、Teacup & teapot 和 Remote 是该智能体领先全部八个后训练策略的三个任务。 这三个任务以及 Perfume 都要求在放置物体之前，先在干扰物中定位指定物体，或在多个格子中定位指定格子。 因此，这些领先结果表明该智能体能够可靠地定位物体和目标，正如附录图 D.1 以 Bookmark 和 Remote 为例、从抓取接近到放置过程所展示的那样。

paragraphs.en: Success declines most steeply with the precision that a task demands. The SR of the agent falls from 60.6% on low-precision tasks to 40.2% on medium-precision tasks and 11.3% on high-precision tasks. Its rank drops accordingly from second to fourth and eighth. On high-precision tasks, OpenWAM- α \alpha and π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} retain 32.5% and 17.5%, respectively. On Peg in hole and Tighten nut, the agent reaches SRs of only 20% and 10% yet mean scores of 0.60 and 0.55. Every unsuccessful episode on these tasks earns 0.50 for positioning the part at the target location and then fails at the final insertion or threading step, as shown in Appendix Figure D.3 . The agent’s failures on these two tasks thus concentrate on the final contact step.
paragraphs.zh: 成功率随任务所需精度要求的最陡下降。 该智能体的 SR 从低精度任务上的 60.6% 下降到中等精度任务上的 40.2% 和高精度任务上的 11.3%。 其排名相应地从第二名降至第四名和第八名。 在高精度任务上，OpenWAM- α \alpha 和 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 分别保持 32.5% 和 17.5%。 在 Peg in hole 和 Tighten nut 任务上，该智能体的 SR 仅为 20% 和 10%，但平均得分分别为 0.60 和 0.55。 如图 D.3 所示，在这些任务上的每次失败回合都在将零件定位到目标位置时获得 0.50 分，然后在最后的插入或拧螺纹步骤中失败。 因此，该智能体在这两个任务上的失败集中在最后的接触步骤。

paragraphs.en: Across the generalization dimensions, the agent’s strength holds even with minimal task context. The post-trained policies are trained on 6,600 episodes, whereas the direct-control agent receives for each task only one annotated demonstration derived from a single training episode. This demonstration cannot fully illustrate the shifts that the test episodes apply along the four dimensions of Object, Background, Instruction, and Mix. Even so, the SR of the direct-control agent stays between 44.2% and 50.8% across the four dimensions, as shown in Figure 2 b and Appendix Table B.4 . This 6.6-point range is the smallest among the agent and the eight post-trained policies. The four policies in Figure 2 b vary more widely: 7.7 points for InternW0- Δ \Delta , 11.5 points for π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} , 16.9 points for OpenWAM- α \alpha , and 21.5 points for Qwen-RobotManip. What the agent takes from the demonstration therefore transfers across these shifts. Moreover, the advantage grows under the Mix dimension, where the object instance, background texture, and instruction phrasing change jointly. Every post-trained policy reaches its lowest SR under Mix. OpenWAM- α \alpha , for example, falls from 61.5% under Background to 44.6% under Mix, and Qwen-RobotManip falls from 55.4% to 33.8%. The direct-control agent, by contrast, maintains 46.2% SR and a 0.643 score under Mix and ranks first on both metrics. In conclusion, the generalization shifts limit the post-trained policies more than the direct-control agent. The limits of the agent lie instead in the manipulation demands of the long-horizon, tabletop, and high-precision groups, which the next subsection examines.
paragraphs.zh: 在各泛化维度上，即使任务上下文极少，智能体的优势依然保持。 后训练策略在 6,600 个回合上进行训练，而直接控制智能体对每个任务仅获得一条来自单个训练回合的标注示范。 该示范无法充分展示测试回合在对象（Object）、背景（Background）、指令（Instruction）和混合（Mix）四个维度上施加的变化。 即便如此，如图 2b 和附录表 B.4 所示，直接控制智能体在这四个维度上的成功率（SR）仍保持在 44.2% 到 50.8% 之间。 这一 6.6 个百分点的波动范围是智能体与八种后训练策略中最小的。 图 2b 中的四种策略波动更大：InternW0-Δ \Delta 为 7.7 个百分点，π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 为 11.5 个百分点，OpenWAM-α \alpha 为 16.9 个百分点，Qwen-RobotManip 为 21.5 个百分点。 因此，智能体从示范中获取的内容能够迁移到这些变化之下。 此外，在 Mix 维度下优势进一步扩大，该维度中对象实例、背景纹理和指令措辞同时发生变化。 每种后训练策略都在 Mix 下达到其最低成功率（SR）。 例如，OpenWAM-α \alpha 从 Background 下的 61.5% 降至 Mix 下的 44.6%，Qwen-RobotManip 从 55.4% 降至 33.8%。 相比之下，直接控制智能体在 Mix 下保持 46.2% 的成功率和 0.643 的分数，在这两项指标上均排名第一。 总之，泛化变化对后训练策略的限制大于对直接控制智能体的限制。 智能体的局限反而在于长时程（long-horizon）、桌面（tabletop）和高精度（high-precision）组的操作要求，下一小节将对此进行考察。

paragraphs.en: Most unsuccessful episodes of the direct-control agent end with partial progress rather than failing initially, which explains the score margin of Section 5.1 . Of the 510 episodes, 237 end in complete success, and 188 of the 273 unsuccessful episodes achieve a nonzero score, so only 85 end at zero, as shown in Figure 3 b. Zero scores concentrate on Gear, Utensils, and Glass into box, where the agent fails before any scored progress in 75%, 65%, and 50% of episodes, respectively. The trajectory analysis below traces the unsuccessful episodes to four mechanisms: imprecise contact geometry, delayed feedback over long horizons, uncoordinated bimanual motion, and unconfirmed completion claims. A final paragraph measures the token cost of the resulting failures.
paragraphs.zh: 直接控制智能体的大多数失败回合并非一开始就失败，而是以部分进展告终，这解释了第 5.1 节中的分数差距。 在 510 个回合中，237 个以完全成功告终，273 个失败回合中有 188 个取得了非零分数，因此只有 85 个回合以零分结束，如图 3b 所示。 零分集中在把齿轮放入盒子、把餐具放入盒子和把玻璃杯放入盒子三项任务上，智能体在这些任务中分别有 75%、65% 和 50% 的回合在取得任何得分进展之前就已失败。 下面的轨迹分析将失败回合归因于四种机制：不精确的接触几何、长时程上的延迟反馈、不协调的双臂运动以及未经确认的完成声明。 最后一段测量了由此产生的失败的 token 开销。

paragraphs.en: Precise contact fails where the agent has to infer geometry from images. The agent does not infer the surface height, part clearance, and contact geometry precisely enough for the final insertion and threading from RGB views and the base-relative EEF pose alone. Post-trained policies receive the same RGB views without depth but map them to contact motions learned from demonstration trajectories. The same limit appears on tasks with moderate nominal precision. On Glass into box, closing the case requires folding both temples inward, but the agent’s corrective pushes leave a temple protruding and prevent the lid from closing, as shown in Appendix Figure D.6 b.
paragraphs.zh: 当智能体需要从图像推断几何信息时，精确接触就会失败。 仅凭 RGB 视图和相对于基座的末端执行器（EEF）位姿，智能体无法足够精确地推断表面高度、零件间隙和接触几何，从而完成最终的插入和旋入。 经过后训练的策略接收同样的无深度信息的 RGB 视图，但将其映射为从演示轨迹中学到的接触动作。 在标称精度中等的任务上也出现了同样的局限。 在“眼镜放入盒中”任务上，合上眼镜盒需要将两侧镜腿向内折叠，但智能体的纠正性推动使一条镜腿仍然外露，导致盒盖无法合上，如附录图 D.6 b 所示。

paragraphs.en: The rollouts of long-horizon tasks point to two causes of failure. First, the agent detects disturbances late and recovers from them slowly. It receives an observation only after each commanded waypoint chunk finishes. Although 84% of its motion commands consist of a single waypoint, each command runs for a median of 48 physics steps, whereas π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} and InternW0- Δ \Delta replan every 30 and 10 physics steps, as Section 6.1 describes. A grasp loss or contact change within a chunk therefore persists until the chunk returns, and the retries that follow consume the remaining physics steps. As a result, the step limit ends 229 of all 273 unsuccessful episodes and is by far their most common ending. Second, the agent plans its approaches and grasps without anticipating how contact will move the object, so the scene becomes unstable over a long task. On Detergent, a bottle tips over or falls during the agent’s own approach, grasp, or transport in 19 of the 20 episodes, and on Bottle this happens in 11 of the 20. The agent must then grasp the fallen bottle again from the table. In one Detergent episode, for example, the agent places the first of three bottles within 11 commands, but the second bottle falls during the next command, which withdraws and approaches over 100 physics steps. The agent spends the remaining 92 commands grasping that bottle again and then the third bottle, which slips during transport. The episode reaches the step limit with two bottles placed. Such cascades accumulate most on Bottle, which is one of the two longest tasks. No evaluated policy or configuration completes Bottle, as analyzed in Section 6.6 .
paragraphs.zh: 长时程任务的推演结果指向两类失败原因。 首先，智能体对扰动的检测滞后，且从中恢复得很慢。 它只在每段被指令的路标点块执行完毕后才接收一次观测。 尽管其 84% 的运动指令只包含单个路标点，但每条指令平均要运行 48 个物理步，而 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 与 InternW0- Δ \Delta 分别每 30 和 10 个物理步重新规划一次，如 6.1 节所述。 因此，块内发生的抓取丢失或接触变化会一直持续到该块返回，而随后的重试会消耗掉剩余的物理步。 结果，步数上限终止了全部 273 个失败回合中的 229 个，是失败回合中最常见的结束方式。 其次，智能体在规划接近与抓取动作时，没有预判接触会如何移动物体，因此在长任务中场景会逐渐变得不稳定。 在 Detergent 任务中，20 个回合里有 19 个出现了瓶子在智能体自身的接近、抓取或搬运过程中倾倒或掉落的情况；在 Bottle 任务中，20 个回合里有 11 个出现这种情况。 此时智能体必须再次从桌面上抓起掉落的瓶子。 例如，在一个 Detergent 回合中，智能体在 11 条指令内放置了三个瓶子中的第一个，但第二个瓶子在下一条指令期间掉落，而该指令的撤回与接近过程持续了超过 100 个物理步。 智能体用剩余的 92 条指令重新抓起该瓶子，然后再处理第三个瓶子，而第三个瓶子在搬运过程中滑落。 该回合在放置了两个瓶子后达到步数上限。 这种级联效应在 Bottle 任务上累积得最多，而 Bottle 是两个最长任务之一。 如 6.6 节所分析的，没有任何被评估的策略或配置能够完成 Bottle 任务。

sents.en: No evaluated policy or configuration completes Bottle, as analyzed in Section 6.6 .
sents.zh: 如 6.6 节所分析的，没有任何被评估的策略或配置能够完成 Bottle 任务。

paragraphs.en: On bimanual tasks, the agent coordinates its two arms only between waypoint chunks. Each chunk executes open loop, so the agent cannot adjust one arm to the contact that the other arm makes during execution, and one hand can withdraw or move before the other has secured the shared object. On Flip cup & cookies, where the cup passes from one hand to the other, the agent fails in 90% of episodes. Appendix Figure D.3 c shows one such episode, in which the supporting hand withdraws during the second handover and the cup falls off the table. On Frame, the agent takes the division of labor between the arms from the demonstration, as analyzed in Section 5.6 . Its SR of 65% on this task exceeds the 50% of OpenWAM- α \alpha but stays below the 95% of Qwen-RobotManip.
paragraphs.zh: 在双手任务中，智能体仅在各路径点块之间协调其两条手臂。 每个块都是开环执行，因此智能体无法在执行过程中根据一条手臂产生的接触来调整另一条手臂，一只手可能在另一只手尚未固定共享物体之前就撤回或移动。 在 Flip cup & cookies 任务中，杯子需要从一只手传递到另一只手，智能体在 90% 的回合中失败。 附录图 D.3 c 展示了这样一个回合，其中支撑的手在第二次交接期间撤回，杯子从桌子上掉落。 在 Frame 任务中，智能体沿用了示范中两条手臂之间的分工，如第 5.6 节所分析。 其在该任务上 65% 的成功率超过了 OpenWAM- \alpha 的 50%，但仍低于 Qwen-RobotManip 的 95%。

paragraphs.en: Finally, the direct-control agent sometimes ends an episode early because it misjudges completion. The agent ends 43 unsuccessful episodes before the step limit, and 21 of them end with a claim of task success while a subgoal remains unmet. Seven of these claims come from Dishwasher, and the agent makes all seven with the door still open, as shown in Appendix Figure D.5 . The instruction of this task asks to put every bowl into the dishwasher, and the last keyframe of the demonstration shows the door closed, yet the agent treats the placement of both bowls as completion. It states an intent to close the door after loading in only one of the 20 episodes, which is also its only success.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，直接控制智能体有时会因为误判任务已完成而提前结束回合。 该智能体在步数上限之前结束了 43 个未成功的回合，其中 21 个在子目标仍未达成的情况下宣告了任务成功。 这些宣告中有 7 个来自洗碗机任务，且智能体在这 7 次中都是在门仍然开着的情况下做出的，如附录图 D.5 所示。 该任务的指令要求把每个碗都放进洗碗机，示范的最后一个关键帧显示门是关着的，但智能体却把两个碗放好即视为完成。 在 20 个回合中，它仅在 1 个回合里表明了装载后关门的意图，而这也是它唯一一次成功。

paragraphs.en: These failures also dominate the token cost of direct control. The agent resends its growing episode context with every call, so the tokens of an episode grow with its number of calls, as detailed in Appendix C.3 . Across the 510 episodes, the Pearson correlation between the two is r = 0.88 r=0.88 . An unsuccessful episode keeps issuing corrections until it reaches the step limit or ends early. On average, it consumes 5.45M tokens over 55.9 calls, roughly three times the 1.84M tokens and twice the 27.4 calls of a successful episode. Long horizons compound this cost, as an episode of a long-horizon task consumes 5.40M tokens against 1.63M on a short-horizon task while succeeding less often. One success on a long-horizon task therefore costs 20.6M tokens when the tokens spent on unsuccessful episodes within each group are included. This cost is about nine times the 2.23M tokens per success on a short-horizon task.
paragraphs.zh: 这些失败同样主导了直接控制的 token 成本。 智能体在每次调用时都会重新发送其不断增长的回合上下文，因此一个回合的 token 数随其调用次数增长，详见附录 C.3。 在 510 个回合中，两者之间的 Pearson 相关系数为 r = 0.88。 不成功的回合会持续发出修正，直到达到步数上限或提前结束。 平均而言，它在 55.9 次调用中消耗了 5.45M 个 token，大约是成功回合 1.84M 个 token 的三倍、27.4 次调用的两倍。 长时程任务加剧了这一成本，长时程任务的一个回合消耗 5.40M 个 token，而短时程任务为 1.63M 个 token，且成功率更低。 因此，若将各组内不成功回合所消耗的 token 计算在内，长时程任务上一次成功需要花费 20.6M 个 token。 这一成本约为短时程任务上每次成功所需 2.23M 个 token 的九倍。

paragraphs.en: The direct-control agent observes the scene only between its own action chunks, yet the returned observations give it in-episode feedback that informs its next decision. After a failed action, the agent records a possible explanation, explores the workspace, and revises its approach. Such in-episode diagnosis is frequent across the 510 episodes: the agent’s stated reasons name a slip, a drop, or a displaced object in 302 of them, as detailed in Appendix B.2 . The two examples in Figure 4 show two forms of this adaptation.
paragraphs.zh: 直接控制型智能体仅在自己的动作块之间观察场景，但返回的观测为其提供了回合内反馈，为其下一步决策提供依据。 在动作失败后，智能体会记录一个可能的解释，探索工作空间，并调整其方法。 这种回合内诊断在 510 个回合中十分常见：智能体所述的原因在其中 302 个回合中提到了打滑、掉落或物体移位，详见附录 B.2。 图 4 中的两个例子展示了这种适应的两种形式。

sents.en: The direct-control agent observes the scene only between its own action chunks, yet the returned observations give it in-episode feedback that informs its next decision.
sents.zh: 直接控制型智能体仅在自己的动作块之间观察场景，但返回的观测为其提供了回合内反馈，为其下一步决策提供依据。

sents.en: After a failed action, the agent records a possible explanation, explores the workspace, and revises its approach.
sents.zh: 在动作失败后，智能体会记录一个可能的解释，探索工作空间，并调整其方法。

sents.en: Such in-episode diagnosis is frequent across the 510 episodes: the agent’s stated reasons name a slip, a drop, or a displaced object in 302 of them, as detailed in Appendix B.2 .
sents.zh: 这种回合内诊断在 510 个回合中十分常见：智能体所述的原因在其中 302 个回合中提到了打滑、掉落或物体移位，详见附录 B.2。

sents.en: The two examples in Figure 4 show two forms of this adaptation.
sents.zh: 图 4 中的两个例子展示了这种适应的两种形式。

paragraphs.en: First, the agent diagnoses failures that occur while a chunk executes and changes its motion strategy accordingly. For example, in the Apple to bowl task of Figure 4 a, the interface reports no failure when the apple slips, but the agent infers a possible slip from the closed finger gap and withdraws to obtain a wider view. After regrasping the apple, it avoids the base motion that preceded the slip, transports the apple with the arm alone, and completes the episode. Second, the agent adjusts the contact geometry with the physical guidance supplied in its prompt. In the Coffee beans task of Figure 4 b, an initial sweep leaves the beans in place. The agent then applies a supplied caveat that the measured local EEF z z -coordinate is not the height above the tabletop, repeats the sweep 25 mm lower, and tilts the fingertips downward to establish contact with the surface.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，智能体诊断分块执行时发生的故障，并据此改变其运动策略。 例如，在图 4 a 的“苹果到碗”任务中，当苹果滑落时界面上报无故障，但智能体从闭合的手指间隙推断可能发生了滑落，于是后退以获得更宽的视野。 重新抓取苹果后，它避免使用滑落前的基准运动，仅用手臂搬运苹果，并完成了整个回合。 其次，智能体根据其提示中提供的物理引导调整接触几何。 在图 4 b 的“咖啡豆”任务中，初次扫掠未能移动咖啡豆。 智能体随后应用提示中提供的一条注意事项，即测得的末端执行器 z 坐标并非相对于桌面的高度，于是将扫掠位置降低 25 mm 重复操作，并将指尖向下倾斜以与表面建立接触。

paragraphs.en: The two episodes thus separate the agent’s diagnosis and adaptation from the precision of its physical execution. In both, the agent states a likely cause of the failure and revises its strategy, and the outcome then depends on how precisely the revised motion makes contact. In the Apple to bowl episode, the revised transport completes the task. In the Coffee beans episode, the lowered and tilted sweep follows the supplied caveat quoted in Appendix D.1 , yet the episode ends at a 0.50 score with the collection incomplete. In-episode adaptation therefore reaches the level of diagnosis and strategy, while fine contact marks the boundary that Section 5.8 locates.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，这两个片段将智能体的诊断与调整同其物理执行的精度区分开来。 在这两个片段中，智能体都给出了失败的一个可能原因并修改了策略，而结果则取决于修改后的动作接触的精准程度。 在苹果到碗的片段中，修改后的搬运完成了任务。 在咖啡豆的片段中，降低并倾斜的清扫动作遵循了附录 D.1 中引用的提示，但该片段最终得分为 0.50，收集未完成。 因此，片段内的调整达到了诊断与策略的层面，而精细接触则构成了 5.8 节所定位的边界。

paragraphs.en: Aggregate task scores do not capture how safely the agent executes its commands, and here the direct-control agent shows clear weaknesses. They stem mainly from unconstrained execution, as the agent drives each command toward its target without accounting for the other arm, the workspace bounds, contact with the scene, or the speed of the motion. Grip losses are common, and more than half of them occur outside grasp tests. Across the 510 episodes under direct control, the gripper-state criteria of Appendix B.2 identify 811 grip losses in 333 episodes. Of these losses, 469 in 265 episodes occur in calls whose stated reasons describe no test of a grasp. Recurring patterns in the recorded rollouts illustrate four resulting hazards, and Appendix Figure D.4 shows the first three. First, independent single-arm commands can destabilize held objects during bimanual tasks. In the Dishwasher task, for example, a bowl slips from the left gripper while the right hand opens the door, as shown in Appendix Figure D.4 a. Second, recovery attempts can drive the robot beyond safe workspace bounds. After an apple falls outside the workspace, for example, the agent keeps requesting EEF targets beneath the table and behind the robot base, as in Appendix Figure D.4 b. Third, height and contact with the scene are hard to judge from RGB images without depth. On Coffee beans, a held jar and later the spoon strike the table edge in an awkward pose, while sweeping motions elsewhere pass above the surface, as in Appendix Figure D.4 c.
paragraphs.zh: 聚合任务分数无法反映智能体执行命令时的安全性，而直接控制的智能体在这方面暴露出明显的弱点。 这些弱点主要源于不受约束的执行，因为智能体在将每条命令推向目标时，既不考虑另一条机械臂，也不考虑工作空间边界、与场景的接触以及运动速度。 抓握丢失很常见，其中超过一半发生在抓取测试之外。 在直接控制下的510个回合中，附录B.2的夹爪状态判据在333个回合中识别出811次抓握丢失。 在这些丢失中，有265个回合里的469次发生在其所述原因并未描述任何抓取测试的调用中。 录制的轨迹回放中反复出现的模式说明了由此产生的四种危害，附录图D.4展示了前三种。 第一，在双手任务中，独立的单臂命令可能使被握持的物体失稳。 例如，在洗碗机任务中，当右手打开机门时，碗从左夹爪中滑落，如附录图D.4 a所示。 第二，恢复尝试可能驱使机器人超出安全的工作空间边界。 例如，在一个苹果掉落到工作空间之外后，智能体持续请求桌面下方和机器人底座后方的末端执行器（EEF）目标，如附录图D.4 b所示。 第三，在没有深度信息的情况下，仅凭RGB图像难以判断高度以及与场景的接触。 在咖啡豆任务中，被握持的罐子以及随后的勺子以别扭的姿态撞到桌沿，而其他地方的清扫动作却从表面上方掠过，如附录图D.4 c所示。

sents.en: Aggregate task scores do not capture how safely the agent executes its commands, and here the direct-control agent shows clear weaknesses.
sents.zh: 聚合任务分数无法反映智能体执行命令时的安全性，而直接控制的智能体在这方面暴露出明显的弱点。

sents.en: They stem mainly from unconstrained execution, as the agent drives each command toward its target without accounting for the other arm, the workspace bounds, contact with the scene, or the speed of the motion.

sents.zh: 第一，在双手任务中，独立的单臂命令可能使被握持的物体失稳。

sents.en: In the Dishwasher task, for example, a bowl slips from the left gripper while the right hand opens the door, as shown in Appendix Figure D.4 a.
sents.zh: 例如，在洗碗机任务中，当右手打开机门时，碗从左夹爪中滑落，如附录图D.4 a所示。

sents.en: Second, recovery attempts can drive the robot beyond safe workspace bounds.
sents.zh: 第二，恢复尝试可能驱使机器人超出安全的工作空间边界。

sents.en: After an apple falls outside the workspace, for example, the agent keeps requesting EEF targets beneath the table and behind the robot base, as in Appendix Figure D.4 b.
sents.zh: 例如，在一个苹果掉落到工作空间之外后，智能体持续请求桌面下方和机器人底座后方的末端执行器（EEF）目标，如附录图D.4 b所示。

sents.en: Third, height and contact with the scene are hard to judge from RGB images without depth.
sents.zh: 第三，在没有深度信息的情况下，仅凭RGB图像难以判断高度以及与场景的接触。

sents.en: On Coffee beans, a held jar and later the spoon strike the table edge in an awkward pose, while sweeping motions elsewhere pass above the surface, as in Appendix Figure D.4 c.
sents.zh: 在咖啡豆任务中，被握持的罐子以及随后的勺子以别扭的姿态撞到桌沿，而其他地方的清扫动作却从表面上方掠过，如附录图D.4 c所示。

paragraphs.en: The fourth hazard concerns the speed of wrist and joint motion. The agent commands target EEF poses directly and relies on the inverse-kinematics solver to compute joint trajectories, so its commands can turn the wrist through large angles within a few physics steps. In 31 of the 510 episodes, a wrist turns through 90 ∘ or more within 24 physics steps, and a joint exceeds 0.08 rad per physics step in 169 episodes. By comparison, the segments that π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} executes in the harness with policy of Section 6 contain no wrist turn this large within 24 physics steps, and they exceed the joint threshold in only 59 episodes, as detailed in Appendix B.2 . On physical hardware, the forces and torques that these fast rotations require risk motor damage or collisions. Together, these cases highlight the need to preserve grasp stability, enforce workspace and motion constraints, and account for contact throughout manipulation before real-world deployment.
paragraphs.zh: 第四类危险涉及腕部和关节的运动速度。 智能体直接指令目标末端执行器（EEF）位姿，并依赖逆运动学求解器计算关节轨迹，因此其指令可能在几个物理步内使腕部转过很大的角度。 在 510 个回合中有 31 个回合，腕部在 24 个物理步内转动了 90 度或更多，且有 169 个回合中某关节在单个物理步内超过 0.08 弧度。 相比之下，π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 在第 6 节策略的评估框架中执行的片段，在 24 个物理步内没有如此大的腕部转动，且仅在 59 个回合中超过关节阈值，详见附录 B.2。 在真实硬件上，这些快速转动所需的力和力矩有导致电机损坏或碰撞的风险。 总之，这些案例突出了在现实部署之前，在操作全程中保持抓取稳定性、执行工作空间与运动约束以及考虑接触问题的必要性。

paragraphs.en: On Frame and Gear, the annotated demonstration conveys task-level structure to the direct-control agent but not the precise action of a final contact step. Appendix D.3 compares runs with and without the demonstration on all 20 test episodes of each task. On Frame, the demonstration raises the number of successful episodes from 1/20 to 13/20 and the mean score from 0.283 to 0.800, because it supplies the two-arm division of labor that zero-shot execution does not find. On Gear, by contrast, both conditions reach 3/20 successes and a mean score of 0.200, although the failures differ. Without the demonstration, the agent leaves the gear outside the assembly region. With it, the agent positions the gear between the mounted gears and lowers it, yet 15 of the 20 episodes still end without a scored stage, so the mean score does not rise above the zero-shot level.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Frame 和 Gear 任务上，标注演示向直接控制的智能体传达了任务级结构，但没有传达最终接触步骤的精确动作。 附录 D.3 在每个任务的全部 20 个测试回合上对比了有演示和无演示的运行结果。 在 Frame 任务上，演示将成功回合数从 1/20 提升到 13/20，平均分从 0.283 提升到 0.800，因为它提供了零样本执行无法发现的双臂分工。 相比之下，在 Gear 任务上，两种条件都只达到 3/20 的成功率和 0.200 的平均分，尽管失败的情形有所不同。 没有演示时，智能体把齿轮留在装配区域之外。 有演示时，智能体将齿轮放置在已装配的齿轮之间并下放，但 20 个回合中仍有 15 个回合最终没有获得任何得分阶段，因此平均分没有超过零样本水平。

paragraphs.en: On two contrasting tasks, the direct-control agent adjusts its grasps and revisits disrupted goals, whereas the post-trained policies execute precise manipulation more accurately. Appendix D.2 sets the agent beside π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} and OpenWAM- α \alpha on Teacup & teapot, where it leads, and on Glass into box, where it trails. On Teacup & teapot, the agent targets the handle region and adjusts its wrist and gripper configuration across attempts. When later manipulation displaces the cup from the saucer, it revisits the cup and carries it back toward the saucer. In contrast, π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} repeats approach and retraction motions without completing the cup transfer, and OpenWAM- α \alpha moves the teapot onto the tray while the cup stays off the saucer. On Glass into box, however, both post-trained policies fold the temples and OpenWAM- α \alpha also closes the lid, whereas the agent’s corrective contacts leave a temple protruding as described in Section 5.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 在两个对比鲜明的任务上，直接控制的智能体能够调整抓取并重新处理被干扰的目标，而经后训练的策略则以更高的准确度执行精细操作。 附录 D.2 将该智能体与 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 和 OpenWAM- α \alpha 在「茶杯与茶壶」上进行对比，前者任务中该智能体领先，而在「玻璃杯放入盒子」任务中则落后。 在「茶杯与茶壶」任务中，该智能体瞄准杯柄区域，并在多次尝试中调整手腕与夹爪的姿态。 当后续操作将杯子从茶托上碰移后，它会重新处理杯子并将其搬回茶托。 相比之下，π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 重复接近与回撤动作而未能完成杯子的转移，而 OpenWAM- α \alpha 则将茶壶放到托盘上，杯子却未放到茶托上。 然而，在「玻璃杯放入盒子」任务中，两个经后训练的策略都折叠了镜腿，OpenWAM- α \alpha 还合上了镜盒盖，而如第 5.3 节所述，该智能体的纠正性接触导致一条镜腿外露突出。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate whether the direct-control agent and post-trained policies can compose skills into a new multi-step sequence, we conduct a pilot experiment with an instruction outside the standard EBench task set: placing a bookmark and then a pen onto the same open book, as shown in Figure 5 . The EBench training set contains placing a bookmark onto a book and placing a pen into a holder or onto a ruler, but not placing a pen onto a book. This setting therefore tests more than the sequencing of two familiar tasks, as the combined objective includes a subtask absent from the robot-policy training data. Completing the first placement in the prescribed order awards a partial score of 0.50. The agent and both post-trained policies each run 10 rollouts, and the agent runs zero-shot without an in-context demonstration. It succeeds in all 10 episodes with a 1.00 mean score by placing the bookmark and then the pen onto the book in the required order. By contrast, π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} and OpenWAM- α \alpha achieve 0/10 successes with mean scores of 0.40 and 0.35, respectively. In their rollouts, both post-trained policies either place the bookmark and stop without initiating the second step or directly manipulate the pen out of order. In this pilot, generalization to individual atomic skills does not yield multi-step compositional execution, whereas the agent’s zero-shot instruction following completes the sequence.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估直接控制的智能体与后训练策略能否将技能组合成新的多步骤序列，我们使用一个标准 EBench 任务集之外的指令进行了一项先导实验：将一个书签、然后再将一支笔放置到同一本打开的书上，如图 5 所示。 EBench 训练集包含将书签放到书上以及将笔放入笔架或放到尺子上，但不包含将笔放到书上。 因此，这一设置所测试的内容超出了对两个熟悉任务的排序，因为组合目标中包含一个机器人策略训练数据中不存在的子任务。 按照规定顺序完成第一个放置动作可获得 0.50 的部分分数。 该智能体与两个后训练策略各运行 10 次回合，且智能体以零样本方式运行，没有任何上下文示例。 它通过按规定顺序先将书签、再将笔放置到书上，在全部 10 个回合中均成功完成，平均得分为 1.00。 相比之下，π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 和 OpenWAM- α \alpha 的成功次数为 0/10，平均得分分别为 0.40 和 0.35。 在它们的回合中，两个后训练策略要么放置书签后停止且未启动第二步，要么不按顺序直接操作笔。 在这项先导实验中，对单个原子技能的泛化并不能带来多步骤的组合执行，而该智能体的零样本指令遵循则完成了整个序列。

paragraphs.en: Taken together, the results of this section place the capability boundary of the direct-control agent at the transition from task-level reasoning to physical execution, and the way in which the agent acts explains why the boundary lies there. On the reasoning side, the semantic and spatial priors of multimodal pretraining supply the task-level knowledge, so that one annotated demonstration per task suffices to direct them. On the execution side, the agent acts through EEF waypoint chunks and observes the scene only after each chunk, so it lacks the continuous physical feedback that precise contact, coordinated two-arm motion, and long horizons require. The post-trained policies learn their control from demonstration trajectories and act on fresh observations throughout execution, so they receive this feedback by design.
paragraphs.zh: 综合来看，本节的结果将直接控制的智能体的能力边界划定在从任务级推理到物理执行的过渡处，而该智能体的行动方式也解释了边界为何位于此处。 在推理方面，多模态预训练的语义与空间先验提供了任务级知识，因此每个任务只需一条标注演示即可对其进行引导。 在执行方面，该智能体通过 EEF 路径点分段进行行动，且仅在每段结束后才观察场景，因此它缺乏精确接触、双臂协调运动和长时程任务所需的连续物理反馈。 后训练策略从演示轨迹中学习控制方式，并在整个执行过程中基于新鲜观测进行行动，因此它们在设计上就获得了这种反馈。

paragraphs.en: This section tests whether combining the agent with post-trained policies can overcome the execution bottlenecks of direct control. We build the harness-with-policy setting following the Harness VLA framework ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) and evaluate it across all 510 EBench test episodes with two representative policies: the VLA π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} ( Black et al., 2025a ) and the WAM InternW0- Δ \Delta ( Miao et al., 2026 ) . We first describe the harness design and compare the two harness configurations with direct control and the standalone policies in overall performance, across task groups, and across generalization dimensions. We then diagnose how failure patterns shift once the agent invokes a policy, analyze its policy invocation behavior, and finally examine the failure modes shared across both policies to identify the sources of the remaining gap. The final subsection also compares the token cost of each configuration.
paragraphs.zh: 本节测试将智能体与后训练策略相结合能否克服直接控制的执行瓶颈。 我们遵循 Harness VLA 框架（Zhang et al., 2026b）构建了带策略的 harness 设置，并在全部 510 个 EBench 测试片段上使用两个代表性策略进行评估：VLA π 0.5 \pi_{0.5}（Black et al., 2025a）和 WAM InternW0- Δ \Delta（Miao et al., 2026）。 我们首先描述 harness 的设计，并将两种 harness 配置与直接控制及独立策略在总体性能、各任务组以及各泛化维度上进行比较。 接着，我们诊断智能体调用策略后失败模式如何变化，分析其策略调用行为，最后考察两种策略共有的失败模式，以确定剩余差距的来源。 最后一个小节还比较了每种配置的 token 开销。

paragraphs.en: Following Harness VLA ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) , our harness with policy exposes a frozen post-trained policy as a callable tool alongside the direct EEF interface described in Section 4.3 , together with a call that returns the annotated task demonstration on request. In each invocation, the agent assigns 1–300 physics steps. Within these steps, the policy acts without intervention from the agent and then returns new visual and proprioceptive observations to the agent. Both harness configurations keep the system prompt, annotated task demonstration, and test scenes fixed and differ in the policy and its execution and history settings. The two policies contrast in temporal conditioning and in standalone strength. For the VLA π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} ( Black et al., 2025a ) , the harness uses the official EBench leaderboard checkpoint. This policy acts on the current observation alone, predicts 50 joint and gripper targets per inference, and replans every 30 physics steps. Evaluated alone, it trails the direct-control agent on both metrics in Table 1 . The WAM InternW0- Δ \Delta ( Miao et al., 2026 ) is likewise post-trained on EBench demonstrations but additionally conditions on two earlier frames of the episode. It predicts 32 joint, gripper, and base targets per inference and replans every 10 physics steps, which is three times as often as π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} , as detailed in Appendix C . Alone, it exceeds direct control on both metrics. Pairing the same agent with both policies therefore asks whether the agent still gains from a policy weaker than itself and whether a policy stronger than the agent lifts the combination beyond both components .
paragraphs.zh: 按照 Harness VLA（Zhang et al., 2026b）的做法，我们的带策略的 harness 将一个冻结的后训练策略作为可调用工具暴露出来，与 4.3 节所述的直接 EEF 接口并列，同时还提供一个调用，可在请求时返回带标注的任务示范。 在每次调用中，智能体分配 1–300 个物理步。 在这些步内，策略在不受智能体干预的情况下执行动作，然后将新的视觉和本体感知观测返回给智能体。 两种 harness 配置保持系统提示、带标注的任务示范和测试场景不变，区别在于策略及其执行和历史设置。 这两个策略在时间条件化和独立强度上形成对比。 对于 VLA π 0.5 \pi_{0.5}（Black et al., 2025a），harness 使用官方 EBench 排行榜检查点。 该策略仅基于当前观测执行动作，每次推理预测 50 个关节和夹爪目标，并每 30 个物理步重新规划一次。 单独评估时，它在表 1 中的两项指标上都落后于直接控制智能体。 WAM InternW0- Δ \Delta（Miao et al., 2026）同样在 EBench 示范上进行过后训练，但额外以该回合中更早的两帧作为条件。 它每次推理预测 32 个关节、夹爪和底座目标，并每 10 个物理步重新规划一次，频率是 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 的三倍，详情见附录 C。 单独使用时，它在两项指标上都超过直接控制。 因此，让同一个智能体分别与这两个策略配对，可以探究：智能体是否仍能从弱于自身的策略中获益，以及强于智能体的策略能否将组合提升到超越两个组件各自表现的水平。

paragraphs.en: Each harness configuration outperforms both of its standalone components in Table 2 , though the gains are asymmetric: pairing with the stronger policy yields the higher overall performance, whereas the weaker policy gains more from the agent. The harness with π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} trails only OpenWAM- α \alpha among these eight. Relative to each policy alone, by contrast, SR rises by 11.6 points with π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} but only by 6.8 points with InternW0- Δ \Delta . Appendix Table C.1 reports the per-task results.

paragraphs.en: These net improvements combine resolved failures with newly failed episodes. Across the 510 paired episodes, the harness with π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} succeeds on 91 episodes that fail under direct control and fails on 59 that succeed under it. The harness with InternW0- Δ \Delta gains 96 episodes and loses 49, as Appendix Table C.2 details. Figure 6 shows where this combination holds across task demands. On six of the seven task groups, each harness configuration comes within three percentage points of the stronger of its two components or exceeds it, whereas on high-precision tasks both configurations remain below the standalone policies. Section 6.3 traces these group results to individual tasks and generalization dimensions, and Section 6.4 then analyzes the episode-level failure patterns behind both.

paragraphs.en: The harness with policy improves task success mainly on long-horizon and tabletop tasks, where the post-trained policy outperforms the agent under direct control, and it keeps the agent’s lead on short-horizon tasks. With either policy, SR increases by roughly 13 percentage points on long-horizon tasks and by 11–14 percentage points on tabletop tasks in Table 2 . These are two of the three groups on which the agent ranks lowest under direct control in Section 5.2 . On these groups, invoking the policy brings the agent to about the level of the policy alone. Specifically, the harness with InternW0- Δ \Delta matches InternW0- Δ \Delta alone on tabletop tasks at 33.6% and stays close to it on long-horizon tasks at 40.4% versus 42.0%. The harness with π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} exceeds π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} alone on both groups, with 40.2% versus 33.4% on long-horizon tasks and 31.4% versus 29.3% on tabletop tasks. On short-horizon tasks, the agent already leads all compared post-trained policies under direct control. Both harness configurations preserve this strong performance and therefore outperform the corresponding policy alone by 18.2 percentage points. On Apple from shelf, for instance, InternW0- Δ \Delta alone achieves 15% SR, whereas the harness with InternW0- Δ \Delta reaches 75% SR. Appendix B.3 details the statistical significance of task-level improvements across all 26 tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 带策略的线束框架主要在长时程任务和桌面任务上提升了任务成功率，在这些任务上经后训练的策略优于直接控制下的智能体，同时在短时程任务上保持了智能体的领先优势。 在表 2 中，无论使用哪种策略，长时程任务的 SR 提升约 13 个百分点，桌面任务的 SR 提升 11–14 个百分点。 这正是 5.2 节中智能体在直接控制下排名最低的三个组中的两个。 在这些组上，调用策略使智能体达到接近策略单独运行的水平。 具体而言，带 InternW0- Δ \Delta 的线束框架在桌面任务上与 InternW0- Δ \Delta 单独运行持平，均为 33.6%，在长时程任务上与其接近，为 40.4% 对 42.0%。 带 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 的线束框架在这两组任务上均超过 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 单独运行的表现，长时程任务上为 40.2% 对 33.4%，桌面任务上为 31.4% 对 29.3%。 在短时程任务上，智能体在直接控制下已经领先所有参与比较的经后训练的策略。 两种线束配置都保持了这一强劲表现，因此比对应的策略单独运行高出 18.2 个百分点。 例如，在“从货架上取苹果”任务中，InternW0- Δ \Delta 单独运行的 SR 为 15%，而带 InternW0- Δ \Delta 的线束框架达到 75% 的 SR。 附录 B.3 详细给出了全部 26 个任务上任务级改进的统计显著性。

paragraphs.en: At the task level, the two largest gains over direct control arise with either policy on Glass into box and Dishwasher, as shown in Figure 7 . On Glass into box, SR increases from 20% under direct control to 85% with π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} and 80% with InternW0- Δ \Delta . On Dishwasher, it increases from 5% to 60% and 75%, respectively. On these two tasks, the invoked policy executes the bimanual transport, temple folding, lid closure, and rack manipulation. These include the stages where the agent under direct control ran out of steps or ended early, as Appendix Figure E.2 a,b illustrates for Glass into box.

paragraphs.en: Two sets of tasks depart from these gains. paragraphs.en: The choice of policy also determines whether the harness keeps the balanced generalization profile of the agent under direct control, as shown in Figure 6 b and d. With π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} , the harness stays above π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} alone on all four dimensions. Over direct control, however, it improves only on Object, where SR rises from 44.2% to 59.2%, and on Instruction, where it rises from 44.6% to 56.2%. On Background and Mix, it remains at about the level of direct control. As a result, its range across dimensions widens from 6.6 to 13.0 points. The newly failed episodes explain this pattern. Resolved failures are distributed evenly at 21 to 25 episodes per dimension. Newly failed episodes, by contrast, concentrate on Background and Mix with 22 and 21 episodes, against only 7 on Object and 9 on Instruction. By failure cause, 25 of these 43 newly failed episodes begin when the agent’s own grasp slips. By task, 21 of the 43 come from just four tasks. Teacup & teapot leads them, as all five of its Background episodes newly fail. With InternW0- Δ \Delta , newly failed episodes are fewer and spread more evenly at 9 to 17 per dimension, against 22 to 26 resolved failures on each. The harness therefore gains on every dimension and surpasses both of its components on each. Its Mix SR of 53.1% and score of 0.718 are the highest of all compared policies and configurations, and its range narrows to 4.6 points, the smallest in Appendix Table B.4 .

paragraphs.en: Table 3 follows how the 510 episodes end under direct control and in each harness configuration. Most unsuccessful episodes reach the physics-step limit in all three configurations, and nearly all of the rest end early with an unconfirmed completion claim or a reported failure of the agent. This section compares each ending between direct control and the harness to show which failures the policy resolves and which it introduces. Section 6.6 then examines the episodes that fail with both policies.

paragraphs.en: Invoking a policy mainly reduces failures at the step limit on long-horizon tasks but rarely resolves those on high-precision tasks, where both policies alone also remain weak. Relative to direct control, unsuccessful episodes that exhaust the physics-step limit decrease from 229 to 201 with π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} and to 178 with InternW0- Δ \Delta , and zero-score episodes decrease from 85 to 79 and 58, respectively. Of the 229 step-limit failures under direct control, 72 succeed with π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} and 76 with InternW0- Δ \Delta , and most of these conversions occur on long-horizon tasks. On high-precision tasks, only 2 and 8 of the 59 step-limit failures succeed, as detailed in Appendix Table C.2 . In the newly successful episodes, the policy executes 78% of the physics steps and typically completes the final stage itself, as it does in every newly successful episode of Dishwasher.
paragraphs.zh: 调用策略主要减少长时程任务在步数上限处的失败，但很少能解决高精度任务上的失败，而在高精度任务上，单独使用两种策略本身也仍然较弱。 相对于直接控制，耗尽物理步数上限的失败回合在使用 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 时从 229 降至 201，使用 InternW0- Δ \Delta 时降至 178；零分回合则分别从 85 降至 79 和 58。 在直接控制下 229 个步数上限失败回合中，使用 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 有 72 个成功，使用 InternW0- Δ \Delta 有 76 个成功，且这些转化大多发生在长时程任务上。 在高精度任务上，59 个步数上限失败回合中分别只有 2 个和 8 个成功，详见附录表 C.2。 在新成功的回合中，该策略执行了 78% 的物理步，并且通常自行完成最后阶段，正如它在 Dishwasher 的每一个新成功回合中所做的那样。

The remaining claims concentrate on two tasks. In these Gear episodes, the agent claims completion while the gear rests unseated near the middle shaft.

paragraphs.en: Object losses, by contrast, end more episodes in the harness configurations. In a grip loss, an object slips from a gripper that remains commanded closed and the fingers close fully, as detected by the criteria of Appendix B.2 . Early terminations in which the agent reports an unrecoverable failure rise from 22 under direct control to 24 with π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} and 33 with InternW0- Δ \Delta , and every one of them in either harness configuration names a lost object. Across the test set, 59 episodes that succeed under direct control newly fail in the harness with π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} , and 49 newly fail with InternW0- Δ \Delta . A call-by-call reading of these episodes shows that the two configurations lose objects in different ways, as reported in Appendix Table C.3 . With π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} , 30 of the 59 begin with a slip of the agent’s own grasp during a lift test or transport. In the Teacup & teapot episode of Appendix Figure E.1 c, for example, segments of π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} end with an empty hand before the agent’s own grasp of the teapot slips. With InternW0- Δ \Delta , 30 of the 49 lose or misplace an object during a policy segment or just after control returns to the agent. Shop leaves little margin for such a loss, as InternW0- Δ \Delta alone needs 4,161 to 4,876 of the 5,000 physics steps in its successful episodes. paragraphs.en: Policy segments hold objects more securely than the agent’s own commands. Within policy segments, grip losses occur 0.63 and 0.72 times per 1,000 held arm-steps with π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} and InternW0- Δ \Delta .
