The losses after a segment arise once control returns to the agent. The harness then holds each gripper at its measured finger width, and the agent receives fresh images together with these widths. Its next command, however, often operates one arm and leaves the holding arm unspecified instead of commanding it to stay closed. Counted per holding arm, such unmaintained grasps occur 338 times after a segment of π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} and 316 times after one of InternW0- Δ \Delta . A grip loss on that arm or a disruption reported in the agent’s next stated reasons follows within two calls in 17% and 19% of these cases, respectively, compared with 6.5% and 9.9% when the agent leaves a holding arm unspecified after one of its own commands in the same harness configuration. Stratified by task, the odds of such a disruption after a policy segment are 2.95 and 1.29 times those after the agent’s own commands, as detailed in Appendix C . All four Detergent episodes that newly fail in the harness with InternW0- Δ \Delta are lost this way, as illustrated in Appendix E.3 . The agent thus does not yet use the returned proprioceptive state to confirm and maintain a grasp that the policy has established.

paragraphs.en: The agent delegates first and takes control back as the episode proceeds. Successful episodes then return control to the policy, whereas unsuccessful ones stay largely under the agent’s own commands. In all 510 episodes with either policy, its first motion command is a policy invocation, and the policy executes 92–97% of the physics steps in the first tenth of an episode, as shown in Figure 8 a. This share declines over the first half as the agent steps in with grasp tests, corrections, and recoveries. In the second half of successful episodes, the policy’s share recovers to 58–64% in the final tenth. Within the same task, successful episodes also leave about 14 points more of their steps to π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} than unsuccessful ones, and about 13 points more to InternW0- Δ \Delta . In unsuccessful episodes, by contrast, the policy’s share keeps falling to 35–36%, and 68% and 72% of these episodes end with a motion command of the agent. Unsuccessful episodes are also longer and contain more transitions between the agent and the policy. They average 7.2 transitions against 4.2 in successful episodes with π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} and 6.8 against 3.8 with InternW0- Δ \Delta . Between transitions, however, the agent keeps control for longer stretches, with 0.26 and 0.24 transitions per motion command against 0.33 and 0.28 in successful episodes, as listed in Appendix Table C.5 . The policy invocations of unsuccessful episodes also ask for recovery more often. With π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} and InternW0- Δ \Delta , 22.0% and 20.7% of these invocations are coded as asking the policy to recover a slipped, missed, or displaced object. These shares are more than three times the 6.3% and 5.8% in successful episodes in Table 3 . Recovery requests thus mark the least successful episodes. Among the episodes with a reported disruption, those with a recovery request fail in 79.3% and 79.0% of cases, against 58.3% and 53.8% of those without one. The agent delegates 35% and 34% of the motion commands whose stated reasons report a slip, a lost object, or another disruption, and it executes the rest itself.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体首先委托策略执行，并随回合推进逐步收回控制权。 成功的回合随即将控制权交还给策略，而失败的回合则在很大程度上由智能体自身指令控制。 在使用任一策略的全部 510 个回合中，其第一条运动指令都是一次策略调用，且在回合的前十分之一内，策略执行了 92–97% 的物理步，如图 8 a 所示。 这一比例在回合前半段下降，因为智能体介入进行抓取测试、修正与恢复。 在成功回合的后半段，策略的份额在最后十分之一回升至 58–64%。 在同一任务内，成功回合与失败回合相比，也将约多 14 个百分点的步数交给 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} ，约多 13 个百分点交给 InternW0- Δ \Delta 。 相比之下，在失败回合中，策略的份额持续下降至 35–36%，且这些回合中分别有 68% 和 72% 以一条智能体的运动指令结束。 失败回合也更长，并且包含更多智能体与策略之间的切换。 在 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 下，失败回合平均切换 7.2 次，而成功回合为 4.2 次；在 InternW0- Δ \Delta 下分别为 6.8 次和 3.8 次。 然而，在两次切换之间，智能体连续保持控制的时间更长，其每条运动指令对应 0.26 和 0.24 次切换，而成功回合为 0.33 和 0.28，详见附录表 C.5 。 失败回合中的策略调用也更频繁地请求恢复。 在 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 和 InternW0- Δ \Delta 下，这些调用中分别有 22.0% 和 20.7% 被标注为请求策略恢复打滑、脱手或位置偏移的物体。 这一比例是表 3 中成功回合的 6.3% 和 5.8% 的三倍以上。 因此，恢复请求标志着最不成功的回合。 在报告了扰动发生的回合中，包含恢复请求的回合有 79.3% 和 79.0% 失败，而不包含恢复请求的回合失败比例为 58.3% 和 53.8%。 在所述原因报告了打滑、物体丢失或其他扰动的运动指令中，智能体将 35% 和 34% 委托出去，其余则由其自身执行。

paragraphs.en: Across tasks, the gain of the harness follows the competence of the policy, but the agent’s delegation does not. On the one hand, the change in SR from direct control tracks the advantage of the policy alone over the agent under direct control, with Pearson correlations of r = 0.77 r=0.77 for π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} and r = 0.68 r=0.68 for InternW0- Δ \Delta , as shown in Figure 8 b. On the other hand, the policy executes on average 66.9% of the physics steps of a task with π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} and 65.4% with InternW0- Δ \Delta . This share is not significantly correlated with the SR of the policy alone, with r = 0.31 r=0.31 and r = 0.23 r=0.23 in Figure 8 c. For example, π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} alone succeeds in at most 10% of episodes on seven tasks, yet the agent still leaves it 60% of the physics steps on these tasks on average and 42–90% per task. paragraphs.en: The agent’s stated reasons show that it divides the work with the policy by subgoal, whereas the policy pursues the whole task. In a successful Flip cup & cookies episode, for instance, the agent tests a grasp with its own waypoints under the stated reason “Test cup grasp by raising 1 cm without rotation”. It then leaves the handover, the reorientation of the cup, and the pour to InternW0- Δ \Delta , as listed in Appendix E.1 . In a Gear episode with π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} , the agent assigns each invocation a stage, from carrying the gear to the middle mounting position to its fine alignment and seating. At times it also assigns a verification such as “Verify the released blue gear remains seated while withdrawing the hand”. The policy, however, is conditioned on the task instruction instead of that stage and reports nothing back. The agent then claims completion after checking only the overview image while the gear rests on the board unseated, as detailed in Appendix E.2 . These episodes show that the agent’s subgoal does not reach the policy upon invocation.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体所述的理由表明，它按照子目标与策略分工，而策略则执行整个任务。 例如，在一次成功的 Flip cup & cookies 回合中，智能体在所述理由「抬起 1 厘米且不旋转以测试杯子抓取」下，用自己的路径点测试了一次抓取。 随后它将交接、杯子的重新定向以及倾倒都交给 InternW0- Δ \Delta 处理，如附录 E.1 所列。 在一次使用 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 的 Gear 回合中，智能体为每次调用分配一个阶段，从将齿轮搬运到中间安装位置，到其精细对准与安放。 有时它还会分配一个验证任务，例如「在撤回手的同时验证已释放的蓝色齿轮是否仍处于安放状态」。 然而，策略是以任务指令而非该阶段为条件，并且不返回任何报告。 于是，智能体在仅查看概览图像后就宣称完成，而此时齿轮实际上并未安放到位地搁在板上，详见附录 E.2。 这些回合表明，智能体的子目标在调用时并未传达给策略。

paragraphs.en: The two harness configurations fail largely on the same tasks. Of the 510 test episodes, 164 fail with both policies. This count is close to the 168 expected if the two configurations failed independently within each task. On the four high-precision tasks, 65 of the 80 episodes fail with both. Shared failures are therefore governed by task-level difficulty rather than by scene-specific factors.
paragraphs.zh: 两种测试框架配置在很大程度上在相同的任务上失败。 在510个测试回合中，有164个在两种策略下均失败。 这一数字接近于如果两种配置在每个任务内独立失败时所预期的168个。 在四个高精度任务上，80个回合中有65个在两种配置下均失败。 因此，共同失败由任务层面的难度决定，而非场景特定因素所致。

sents.en: The two harness configurations fail largely on the same tasks.
sents.zh: 两种测试框架配置在很大程度上在相同的任务上失败。

sents.en: Of the 510 test episodes, 164 fail with both policies.
sents.zh: 在510个测试回合中，有164个在两种策略下均失败。

sents.en: This count is close to the 168 expected if the two configurations failed independently within each task.
sents.zh: 这一数字接近于如果两种配置在每个任务内独立失败时所预期的168个。

sents.en: On the four high-precision tasks, 65 of the 80 episodes fail with both.

sents.en: Shared failures are therefore governed by task-level difficulty rather than by scene-specific factors.
sents.zh: 因此，共同失败由任务层面的难度决定，而非场景特定因素所致。

paragraphs.en: Within these shared failures, however, where an episode breaks along its chain of grasping, transfer, and contact depends on the policy. The two runs of an episode end with the same category of decisive incident in only 58 of the 164 episodes, as broken down in Appendix Table C.4 . First, object losses decide 109 shared failures with π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} and 105 with InternW0- Δ \Delta , and their location shifts with the policy. With π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} , 58 of these losses occur during the agent’s own lift tests and transport and 37 inside policy segments. With InternW0- Δ \Delta , the order reverses, as 53 occur inside policy segments and 42 during the agent’s own lift tests and transport. The remaining 14 and 10 follow a grasp left unmaintained after a policy segment, as analyzed in Section 6.4 . Second, 19 and 24 shared failures stall at the final insertion, threading, or seating stage, and 16 and 15 spend policy segments empty-handed or on the wrong object. Third, 19 and 20 shared failures end without a single decisive object loss. Of these, 16 and 11 reach the step limit as recovered slips, empty grasps, and displaced objects accumulate. Bottle accounts for 14 of these 27 step-limit runs, and in 11 of the 14, bottles slip, fall beside or behind the basket, or lie outside it. No run on Bottle places more than 9 of the 12 bottles. The other 3 and 9 end with a false completion claim.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，在这些共同的失败之中，一次试验究竟在抓取、搬运与接触链条的哪个环节断裂，取决于策略。 如附录表 C.4 所示，164 次试验中仅有 58 次的两次运行以同一类决定性事件告终。 首先，物体丢失在与 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 的共同失败中决定了 109 次，在与 InternW0- Δ \Delta 中决定了 105 次，且其发生位置随策略而变化。 在 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 下，这些丢失中有 58 次发生在智能体自己的提举测试与搬运期间，37 次发生在策略段内部。 在 InternW0- Δ \Delta 下，顺序正好相反：53 次发生在策略段内部，42 次发生在智能体自己的提举测试与搬运期间。 剩余的 14 次和 10 次则源于策略段结束后未能维持的抓取，如第 6.4 节所分析。 其次，有 19 次和 24 次共同失败停滞在最终的插入、穿线或安放阶段，有 16 次和 15 次在策略段中空手操作或抓取了错误的物体。 第三，有 19 次和 20 次共同失败在没有任何一次决定性物体丢失的情况下结束。 其中，有 16 次和 11 次是在 recovered slips、空抓取和物体位移不断累积的情况下达到步数上限。 在这 27 次达到步数上限的运行中，Bottle 占 14 次，而这 14 次中有 11 次是瓶子滑落、掉到篮子旁边或后面，或落在篮子之外。 在 Bottle 上没有任何一次运行能放置超过 12 个瓶子中的 9 个。 另有 3 次和 9 次以虚假的完成声明告终。

paragraphs.en: The harness with policy moves the boundary of Section 5.8 where the policy supplies the closed-loop execution that direct control lacks, chiefly on the long-horizon and tabletop tasks. Two limits remain, and a final paragraph examines how the shift changes the agent’s token cost.
paragraphs.zh: 带策略的测试框架移动了 5.8 节的边界，因为策略提供了直接控制所缺乏的闭环执行，主要体现在长时程和桌面任务上。 仍存在两个局限，最后一段考察了这种转变如何改变智能体的 token 成本。

sents.en: The harness with policy moves the boundary of Section 5.8 where the policy supplies the closed-loop execution that direct control lacks, chiefly on the long-horizon and tabletop tasks.
sents.zh: 带策略的测试框架移动了 5.8 节的边界，因为策略提供了直接控制所缺乏的闭环执行，主要体现在长时程和桌面任务上。

sents.en: Two limits remain, and a final paragraph examines how the shift changes the agent’s token cost.
sents.zh: 仍存在两个局限，最后一段考察了这种转变如何改变智能体的 token 成本。

paragraphs.en: First, the agent and both policies share an execution ceiling on high-precision contact, so combining them does not lift it. A per-task choice in hindsight between the agent alone and the policy alone reaches only 21.3% SR on the high-precision tasks with either policy. The best of all three components reaches 30.0%, which remains below the 32.5% of OpenWAM- α \alpha .
paragraphs.zh: 首先，智能体与两个策略在高精度接触上共享同一个执行上限，因此将它们结合并不能提升该上限。 事后在仅使用智能体和仅使用策略之间进行逐任务选择，无论使用哪个策略，在高精度任务上只能达到 21.3% 的成功率（SR）。 三个组件中最好的组合达到 30.0%，仍低于 OpenWAM-α \alpha 的 32.5%。

sents.en: First, the agent and both policies share an execution ceiling on high-precision contact, so combining them does not lift it.
sents.zh: 首先，智能体与两个策略在高精度接触上共享同一个执行上限，因此将它们结合并不能提升该上限。

sents.en: A per-task choice in hindsight between the agent alone and the policy alone reaches only 21.3% SR on the high-precision tasks with either policy.
sents.zh: 事后在仅使用智能体和仅使用策略之间进行逐任务选择，无论使用哪个策略，在高精度任务上只能达到 21.3% 的成功率（SR）。

sents.en: The best of all three components reaches 30.0%, which remains below the 32.5% of OpenWAM- α \alpha .
sents.zh: 三个组件中最好的组合达到 30.0%，仍低于 OpenWAM-α \alpha 的 32.5%。

paragraphs.en: Second, the combination loses part of what its components achieve alone. The per-task choice of the better component would attain 56.2% with π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} and 60.8% with InternW0- Δ \Delta . It would thus exceed the respective harness configuration by 3.1 and 4.8 points over all tasks and by 13.8 and 8.8 points on the high-precision tasks. The harness with π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} exceeds both of its components on only ten tasks and falls below the better one on thirteen. The harness with InternW0- Δ \Delta exceeds both on eight tasks and falls below the better one on eleven. The preceding analyses trace this loss to three sources in how agent and policy coordinate. First, the agent allocates physics steps to the policy by task horizon rather than by the policy’s competence on the task, as shown in Section 6.5 . Second, each policy segment conditions on the task instruction and the observations listed in Section 6.1 rather than on the agent’s subgoal or the stages already completed, as shown in Section 6.5 . Third, once a policy segment ends, the agent does not command the holding arm to stay closed at the returned finger width, as shown in Section 6.4 .
paragraphs.zh: 其次，这种组合损失了其各组件单独所能达成的部分能力。 逐任务选择更优组件的方式，使用 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 可达 56.2%，使用 InternW0- Δ \Delta 可达 60.8%。 因此，它将在全部任务上分别超出对应框架配置 3.1 和 4.8 个百分点，在高精度任务上分别超出 13.8 和 8.8 个百分点。 使用 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 的框架仅在十个任务上同时超越其两个组件，而在十三个任务上低于其中更优者。 使用 InternW0- Δ \Delta 的框架在八个任务上同时超越两者，在十一个任务上低于其中更优者。 前述分析将这一损失归因于智能体与策略协作方式中的三个来源。 其一，智能体按任务时长而非按策略在该任务上的胜任程度来为策略分配物理步骤，如第 6.5 节所示。 其二，每个策略片段以任务指令和第 6.1 节所列的观测为条件，而非以智能体的子目标或已完成的阶段为条件，如第 6.5 节所示。 其三，一旦策略片段结束，智能体不会命令夹持臂在返回的手指宽度处保持闭合，如第 6.4 节所示。

sents.en: Second, the combination loses part of what its components achieve alone.
sents.zh: 其次，这种组合损失了其各组件单独所能达成的部分能力。

sents.en: The per-task choice of the better component would attain 56.2% with π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} and 60.8% with InternW0- Δ \Delta .
sents.zh: 逐任务选择更优组件的方式，使用 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 可达 56.2%，使用 InternW0- Δ \Delta 可达 60.8%。

sents.en: It would thus exceed the respective harness configuration by 3.1 and 4.8 points over all tasks and by 13.8 and 8.8 points on the high-precision tasks.
sents.zh: 因此，它将在全部任务上分别超出对应框架配置 3.1 和 4.8 个百分点，在高精度任务上分别超出 13.8 和 8.8 个百分点。

sents.en: The harness with π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} exceeds both of its components on only ten tasks and falls below the better one on thirteen.
sents.zh: 使用 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 的框架仅在十个任务上同时超越其两个组件，而在十三个任务上低于其中更优者。

sents.en: The harness with InternW0- Δ \Delta exceeds both on eight tasks and falls below the better one on eleven.
sents.zh: 使用 InternW0- Δ \Delta 的框架在八个任务上同时超越两者，在十一个任务上低于其中更优者。

sents.en: The preceding analyses trace this loss to three sources in how agent and policy coordinate.
sents.zh: 前述分析将这一损失归因于智能体与策略协作方式中的三个来源。

sents.en: First, the agent allocates physics steps to the policy by task horizon rather than by the policy’s competence on the task, as shown in Section 6.5 .
sents.zh: 其一，智能体按任务时长而非按策略在该任务上的胜任程度来为策略分配物理步骤，如第 6.5 节所示。

sents.en: Second, each policy segment conditions on the task instruction and the observations listed in Section 6.1 rather than on the agent’s subgoal or the stages already completed, as shown in Section 6.5 .
sents.zh: 其二，每个策略片段以任务指令和第 6.1 节所列的观测为条件，而非以智能体的子目标或已完成的阶段为条件，如第 6.5 节所示。

sents.en: Third, once a policy segment ends, the agent does not command the holding arm to stay closed at the returned finger width, as shown in Section 6.4 .
sents.zh: 其三，一旦策略片段结束，智能体不会命令夹持臂在返回的手指宽度处保持闭合，如第 6.4 节所示。

paragraphs.en: Invoking a policy also moves computation from the agent into the policy. The agent consumes 1.83M tokens per episode with π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} and 2.22M with InternW0- Δ \Delta , which is 52% and 41% less than the 3.77M under direct control. It also makes 23.7 and 22.7 tool calls per episode instead of 42.6. Per success, it needs 3.5M and 4.0M tokens, which is 57% and 51% fewer than the 8.1M under direct control. The savings concentrate where direct control is most expensive, as shown in Figure 9 . On long-horizon tasks, one success costs 6.2M and 7.5M tokens in the two harness configurations, which is less than two fifths of its cost under direct control. On short-horizon tasks, the cost per success falls by only a quarter to a third. Within each configuration, unsuccessful episodes still consume 2.6 and 2.4 times the tokens of successful ones, because tokens grow with the number of calls in the harness as well. At the published tariff of GPT-6-Astra, the agent’s tokens cost USD 16.82 per success under direct control but only 4.99 and 5.49 in the two harness configurations, as detailed in Appendix C.3 . In exchange, the policy adds 45 inferences of π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} and 135 of InternW0- Δ \Delta per episode.
paragraphs.zh: 调用策略还会把计算从智能体转移到策略之中。 智能体在使用 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 时每个回合消耗 1.83M 个 token，使用 InternW0- Δ \Delta 时消耗 2.22M 个 token，相比直接控制下的 3.77M 分别减少了 52% 和 41%。 它每个回合的工具调用次数也从 42.6 次降至 23.7 次和 22.7 次。 按每次成功计算，它需要 3.5M 和 4.0M 个 token，比直接控制下的 8.1M 分别少 57% 和 51%。 这些节省集中在直接控制成本最高的地方，如图 9 所示。 在长时程任务上，两种 harness 配置下每次成功的成本分别为 6.2M 和 7.5M 个 token，不到直接控制下成本的五分之二。 在短时程任务上，每次成功的成本仅下降四分之一到三分之一。 在每种配置内部，失败的回合仍消耗成功回合 2.6 倍和 2.4 倍的 token，因为 harness 中的 token 数量也会随调用次数增长。 按 GPT-6-Astra 的公布价格计算，直接控制下智能体每次成功的 token 成本为 16.82 美元，而两种 harness 配置下分别仅为 4.99 和 5.49 美元，详见附录 C.3。 作为交换，策略在每个回合增加 45 次 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 推理和 135 次 InternW0- Δ \Delta 推理。

paragraphs.en: This report profiles GPT-6-Astra on EBench as the core of an agent that controls a robot through an agent harness. The agent observes the scene under the same visual and proprioceptive protocol as post-trained policies and acts first under direct control and then in a harness with a post-trained VLA or WAM. Under direct control, the capability boundary of the agent lies between flexible task interpretation and reliable physical execution. Without robot-specific post-training of the MLLM, the direct-control agent draws on multimodal pretraining and one annotated demonstration for each task to compete with post-trained policies overall, with particular strengths in visual grounding, robustness to generalization shifts, adaptation to failures during an episode, and zero-shot composition of skills. Physical execution, by contrast, exposes a tension in how the agent controls the robot. The agent chooses its corrections between waypoint chunks, whereas grasps, contacts, and the alignment of parts evolve within each chunk, so precise contact, bimanual coordination, and long horizons limit its success. Because each correction also resends the accumulated context, the unsuccessful and long-horizon episodes that this tension produces account for most of the agent’s token cost. The same unconstrained execution also drops held objects outside the agent’s deliberate grasp tests and at times produces abrupt wrist rotations that risk damaging physical hardware.
paragraphs.zh: 本报告介绍了 GPT-6-Astra 在 EBench 上的表现，该模型作为智能体的核心，通过智能体套件（agent harness）控制机器人。 该智能体在与后训练策略相同的视觉和本体感觉协议下观察场景，先在直接控制下行动，然后在配备后训练 VLA 或 WAM 的套件中行动。 在直接控制下，智能体的能力边界位于灵活的任务解读与可靠的物理执行之间。 在未对 MLLM 进行机器人专项后训练的情况下，直接控制智能体凭借多模态预训练以及每个任务一段标注演示，在整体上与后训练策略相当，并在视觉定位、对泛化偏移的鲁棒性、对回合内故障的适应以及技能的零样本组合方面具有突出优势。 相比之下，物理执行则暴露出智能体在控制机器人方式上的矛盾。 智能体在路径点块（waypoint chunk）之间选择其修正动作，而抓取、接触以及部件对齐却在每个块内部演化，因此精确接触、双臂协调和长时程任务限制了它的成功率。 由于每次修正还会重新发送累积的上下文，这种矛盾导致的不成功和长时程回合占了智能体大部分的 token 开销。 同样这种不受约束的执行方式，还会在智能体有意进行的抓取测试之外掉落所持物体，有时还会产生可能损坏物理硬件的突然腕部旋转。

paragraphs.en: Invoking a post-trained policy moves part of this boundary. With InternW0- Δ \Delta , the harness with policy reaches the highest SR and score in Table 1 , and with either policy the agent needs far fewer tokens per success on long-horizon tasks, where direct control is costliest. However, two shortfalls of the combination indicate where further progress is needed. First, precise contact limits the agent and each policy alike, so combining them leaves this ceiling in place. Second, the combination falls short of its better component on many tasks, because the coordination between agent and policy remains loose. The agent delegates without regard to the policy’s competence, the policy pursues the task instruction rather than the agent’s subgoal, and when control returns from the policy, the agent often leaves the holding arm unmaintained, allowing grasped objects to slip. These limitations motivate us to explore several directions.
paragraphs.zh: 调用后训练策略会移动这一边界的部分位置。 使用 InternW0-Δ\Delta 时，配备策略的框架在表 1 中取得了最高的成功率和得分，并且无论采用哪种策略，智能体在长程任务上每次成功所需的 token 数都大幅减少，而这类任务正是直接控制成本最高的场景。 然而，这种组合的两个不足之处指明了进一步改进的方向。 首先，精确接触同时限制了智能体和每个策略本身，因此将二者结合也无法突破这一上限。 其次，这种组合在许多任务上的表现不及其中更强的组件，因为智能体与策略之间的协调仍然松散。 智能体在委派任务时不考虑策略的能力，策略 pursuit 的是任务指令而非智能体的子目标，并且当控制权从策略交还给智能体后，智能体往往不再维持持握手臂，导致被抓取的物体滑落。 这些局限性促使我们探索若干改进方向。

paragraphs.en: In the evaluated harness, the agent passes the policy only a step count, so it decides when the policy acts but can neither assign a subgoal nor receive a report of its completion. A finer interface would not only expose learned skills as tools that a planner selects ( RLinf, 2026 ) but also pass an explicit subgoal to the policy, verify the entry and exit conditions of each subtask ( Xu et al., 2026 ) , and return whether the subgoal was reached. Such an interface also requires a policy that can serve it. The evaluated policies are post-trained on complete EBench task trajectories under the task instruction, whereas the harness invokes them mid-episode from states that the agent has reached and for subgoals that the agent has chosen. The policy itself therefore has to be trained as a learnable tool of the harness. This training spans three levels and can build on the subtask instruction following of π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} ( Black et al., 2025a ) and on the subtask descriptions and execution feedback that the authors of InternW0- Δ \Delta list as future extensions of its interface ( Miao et al., 2026 ) . First, the policy should follow the agent’s subgoals rather than only the task instruction. Second, it should be trained on the mid-episode states in which the agent transfers control, including disturbed and displaced ones. Third, it should end each segment on subgoal completion or failure, returning structured feedback to the agent and leaving any held object in a stable grasp. The agent, in turn, can be trained to delegate a subtask according to the policy’s competence on it and to use the proprioceptive state returned at every control transfer to keep a held object grasped.
paragraphs.zh: 在被评估的测试框架中，智能体仅向策略传递一个步数，因此它可以决定策略何时行动，但既不能分配子目标，也无法收到子目标完成的报告。 更精细的接口不仅能把学习到的技能暴露为规划器可选择的工具（ RLinf, 2026 ），还能向策略传递显式的子目标，验证每个子任务的进入与退出条件（ Xu et al., 2026 ），并返回子目标是否达成。 这样的接口也需要一个能够支撑它的策略。 被评估的策略是在任务指令下基于完整的 EBench 任务轨迹进行后训练的，而测试框架是在智能体已达成的状态中、针对智能体所选的子目标、于回合中途调用它们。 因此，策略本身必须被训练为测试框架的一个可学习工具。 这一训练跨越三个层次，并且可以借鉴 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 的子任务指令遵循能力（ Black et al., 2025a ），以及 InternW0- Δ \Delta 的作者在其接口的未来扩展中所列出的子任务描述与执行反馈（ Miao et al., 2026 ）。 首先，策略应遵循智能体的子目标，而不仅仅是任务指令。 其次，应在智能体移交控制权时所处的回合中途状态上对其进行训练，包括受扰动和被移动的状态。 第三，策略应在每个片段结束于子目标完成或失败时，向智能体返回结构化反馈，并使所持物体保持在稳定的抓握状态。 相应地，智能体可以被训练为依据策略在子任务上的能力来委派子任务，并利用每次控制权移交时返回的本体感受状态，保持所持物体处于被抓握状态。

sents.en: Third, it should end each segment on subgoal completion or failure, returning structured feedback to the agent and leaving any held object in a stable grasp.
sents.zh: 第三，策略应在每个片段结束于子目标完成或失败时，向智能体返回结构化反馈，并使所持物体保持在稳定的抓握状态。

sents.en: The agent, in turn, can be trained to delegate a subtask according to the policy’s competence on it and to use the proprioceptive state returned at every control transfer to keep a held object grasped.
sents.zh: 相应地，智能体可以被训练为依据策略在子任务上的能力来委派子任务，并利用每次控制权移交时返回的本体感受状态，保持所持物体处于被抓握状态。

paragraphs.en: Within an episode, the agent diagnoses slips and displaced objects and revises its strategy, yet every new episode starts again from the same static prompt. Recent work turns such experience into reusable assets. Language-model programs compose perception and control APIs into robot behavior ( Liang et al., 2023 ) , and recent harnesses synthesize task programs around post-trained policies ( Wang et al., 2026a ) , expose embodiment-specific primitives ( Chen et al., 2026 ) , or extend their control interfaces during deployment ( Li et al., 2026c ) . To admit only experience that generalizes, recent work also validates candidate skills on held-out episodes ( Lu et al., 2026 ) and isolates the evaluation from the agent that revises its own prompt and tools ( Elmaaroufi et al., 2026 ) . For embodied agents, two questions follow: which recoveries generalize beyond a single trial, and whether experience accumulated with one MLLM serves other MLLMs as well. The stated reasons of the agent offer a natural starting point, as each names a diagnosed failure together with the revised action that follows it. Validated pairs of failure and revision can be retained across episodes as memory or compiled into tools that wrap closed-loop control.
paragraphs.zh: 在单个回合（episode）内，智能体能够诊断操作失误和物体错位并修订其策略，但每个新回合都从同一份静态提示词重新开始。 近期工作将这类经验转化为可复用的资产。 语言模型程序将感知与控制 API 组合成机器人行为（Liang et al., 2023），近期的框架（harness）则围绕后训练策略合成任务程序（Wang et al., 2026a）、暴露特定具身形态的原语（Chen et al., 2026），或在部署过程中扩展其控制接口（Li et al., 2026c）。 为了只采纳可泛化的经验，近期工作还在留出的回合上验证候选技能（Lu et al., 2026），并将评估与修订自身提示词和工具的智能体相隔离（Elmaaroufi et al., 2026）。 对于具身智能体，随之而来的有两个问题：哪些恢复行为能泛化到单次试验之外，以及用一个多模态大语言模型（MLLM）积累的经验是否同样适用于其他 MLLM。 智能体自述的原因是自然的切入点，因为每条原因都指出了一个被诊断出的失败，以及随后采取的修订动作。 经过验证的「失败—修订」配对可以跨回合保留为记忆，或被编译为封装闭环控制的工具。

paragraphs.en: The recorded rollouts contain corrective strategies such as withdrawing for a wider view after a slip and lowering a sweep that missed the beans. The agent produces these strategies at the latency and token cost of a frontier MLLM. Distilling them into smaller models that run at deployment speed would pair failure states with the agent’s revised strategies and their outcomes, including corrections that did not succeed. Such distillation would thereby extend behavior cloning from trajectories toward the intentions behind them. Policies already improve from their own experience and from corrective interventions ( Physical Intelligence et al., 2025 ) , and an LLM agent can run the cycle of training and evaluating a VLA without a human in the loop ( Yu, 2026 ) . Because agent rollouts carry the reason for every correction, they extend such training data to corrections that the agent discovers on its own.
paragraphs.zh: 录制的 rollout 数据中包含纠正性策略，例如在失误后后退以获得更宽的视野，以及放低一次漏掉了豆子的扫动。 智能体以前沿 MLLM 的延迟和 token 成本产生这些策略。 将它们蒸馏成能以部署速度运行的小模型，可以把失败状态与智能体的修正策略及其结果配对，包括那些未成功的纠正。 这样的蒸馏因此会将行为克隆从轨迹扩展到轨迹背后的意图。 策略已经能够从自身经验和纠正性干预中改进（ Physical Intelligence et al., 2025 ），并且 LLM 智能体可以在无人工参与的情况下运行训练与评估 VLA 的循环（ Yu, 2026 ）。 由于智能体的 rollout 数据带有每次纠正的原因，它们将此类训练数据扩展到了智能体自行发现的纠正上。

paragraphs.en: Precise contact and safe execution both depend on geometry that the agent infers from RGB views without depth. On insertion, threading, and seating, the agent has to judge the height of a surface, the clearance of a part, and the onset of contact from images, and its commands reach the robot without checks against the table, the workspace bounds, or the speed of the motion. The harness can therefore pair perception tools with a safety layer. Perception tools such as depth estimation, open-vocabulary detection and segmentation, and visual checks of the terminal state can estimate these quantities from the same camera views. The safety layer can check each command against workspace, reachability, and velocity limits and interrupt chunk execution on slip or collision. On real hardware, a queryable model of the robot’s body already lets an agent convert functional targets into control targets ( Lou et al., 2026 ) , and such a model can supply the kinematic limits that this safety layer enforces. Reporting safety events beside SR and score would let benchmarks measure this progress.
paragraphs.zh: 精确接触与安全执行都依赖于智能体在无深度信息的情况下从 RGB 视图推断出的几何信息。 在插入、穿线和安放任务中，智能体必须从图像中判断表面的高度、零件的间隙以及接触的发生，而其指令到达机器人时不会对桌面、工作空间边界或运动速度进行任何校验。 因此，测试框架可以将感知工具与安全层配对使用。 诸如深度估计、开放词汇检测与分割以及终端状态视觉检查等感知工具，可以从相同的相机视图中估计这些量。 安全层可以根据工作空间、可达性和速度限制校验每条指令，并在打滑或碰撞时中断指令块的执行。 在真实硬件上，一个可查询的机器人本体模型已经能让智能体将功能性目标转换为控制目标（Lou et al., 2026），而这样的模型可以提供该安全层所执行的的运动学限制。 在 SR 和分数之外报告安全事件，将使基准测试能够衡量这方面的进展。

paragraphs.en: This report mainly studies the capability profile of one frontier MLLM, GPT-6-Astra, as the core of an agent on one simulated benchmark with synchronous execution, both under direct control and in a harness with two post-trained policies. Natural extensions include measuring the agent’s execution time, asynchronous execution in which the scene keeps evolving while the model deliberates, self-improvement of the agent with or without training the post-trained policy, a full evaluation of other frontier MLLMs as agent cores under the same protocol, and deployment on a physical robot. Appendix B.2 lists the protocol of each run.
paragraphs.zh: 本报告主要研究一个前沿多模态大语言模型（MLLM）GPT-6-Astra 作为智能体核心，在一个具有同步执行的模拟基准上，分别在直接控制和带有两个后训练策略的框架下的能力画像。 自然的扩展包括：测量智能体的执行时间、场景在模型推理期间持续演化的异步执行、智能体在不训练或训练后训练策略情况下的自我改进、在同一协议下对其他前沿 MLLM 作为智能体核心的全面评估，以及在物理机器人上的部署。 附录 B.2 列出了每次运行（run）的协议。

sents.en: This report mainly studies the capability profile of one frontier MLLM, GPT-6-Astra, as the core of an agent on one simulated benchmark with synchronous execution, both under direct control and in a harness with two post-trained policies.
sents.zh: 本报告主要研究一个前沿多模态大语言模型（MLLM）GPT-6-Astra 作为智能体核心，在一个具有同步执行的模拟基准上，分别在直接控制和带有两个后训练策略的框架下的能力画像。

sents.en: Appendix B.2 lists the protocol of each run.
sents.zh: 附录 B.2 列出了每次运行（run）的协议。

paragraphs.en: Complete this single task yourself using the tools: Take out one of the three bowls and stack it on the plate. Robot: manip/lift2/R5a, two arms and a movable planar base. Left arm is left in the overlook view. EEF poses are local to each arm’s planner base: +X forward, +Y robot-left, +Z up; quaternion order wxyz. [...] There is no supplied depth, object pose or camera calibration. Only RGB and measured robot EEF/gripper/base state are available. [...] Use execute_eef sequentially, not parallel calls. Use observations to judge motion and object manipulation. The server determines task success independently. Do not start another episode. Resource limits: unlimited tool calls, physics deadline enforced by the server; no hard token limit; [...] When finished, state the observed outcome concisely. You may call execute_pi05 to delegate a manipulation segment to a learned policy. Choose when to delegate using the current scene. It replans every 30 steps and automatically returns control after the requested segment (at most 300 steps). paragraphs.en: Tables B.2 and B.3 give the SR and score of the agent and the eight post-trained policies on every test task. Relative to the best post-trained policy on each task in Table B.2 , the agent’s SR is higher on three tasks, equal on five, and lower on eighteen. The three higher tasks are all mobile: Bookmark on book, Remote to holder, and Teacup, saucer & teapot. The five equal tasks are Dish, Pen, Perfume to cosmetics rack, Salt to spice rack, and Bottle, which no policy solves. The largest deficits occur on Dishwasher, Flip cup & collect cookies, and Glass into glassbox, where the agent reaches 5%, 10%, and 20% against 90% for the best post-trained policy. These three tasks involve an articulated object, coordinated use of both arms, and two-arm transfer with folding, respectively. The outcome breakdown separates two kinds of shortfall. On Tighten nut, Peg in hole, and Shop, no episode ends with a score of zero, so unsuccessful episodes receive partial credit for completed stages. On Gear installation and Utensils to holder, 15 and 13 of the 20 episodes end with a score of zero, so in these episodes the agent fails before completing the first scored stage.
paragraphs.zh: 表 B.2 和 B.3 给出了智能体与八个后训练策略在每个测试任务上的成功率（SR）和得分。 相对于表 B.2 中每个任务上最优的后训练策略，智能体的成功率在三个任务上更高，在五个任务上相等，在十八个任务上更低。 三个更高的任务全部是移动操作任务：书上的书签（Bookmark on book）、遥控器放到支架上（Remote to holder）以及茶壶、茶托与茶杯（Teacup, saucer & teapot）。 五个相等的任务是洗碗机餐具（Dish）、笔（Pen）、香水放到化妆品架上（Perfume to cosmetics rack）、盐放到调料架上（Salt to spice rack）以及瓶子（Bottle），这些任务没有任何策略能解决。 差距最大的是洗碗机餐具（Dishwasher）、翻转杯子并收集饼干（Flip cup & collect cookies）以及玻璃杯放入玻璃盒（Glass into glassbox），智能体分别达到 5%、10% 和 20%，而最优后训练策略为 90%。 这三个任务分别涉及带关节的物体、双臂的协同使用，以及需要折叠的双臂转移操作。 结果分解区分了两种不足。 在拧螺母（Tighten nut）、插销入孔（Peg in hole）和购物（Shop）上，没有任何回合以零分结束，因此未成功的回合会因完成的部分阶段而获得部分得分。 在齿轮安装（Gear installation）和餐具放到支架上（Utensils to holder）上，20 个回合中分别有 15 个和 13 个以零分结束，因此在这些回合中，智能体在完成第一个计分阶段之前就已失败。

paragraphs.en: The horizon labels follow the corrected annotation of the benchmark designers, which differs from the grouping displayed on the leaderboard. When the agent ends an episode, the robot is held in place until the evaluation server determines the outcome, and 6 of the 49 direct-control episodes that the agent ended early succeeded during this hold. In the 56 direct-control episodes interrupted by an infrastructure failure, execution resumed from the unchanged simulator state in a new model thread initialized with the recorded action history and the current observations. The direct-control run evaluated Bottle and Shop with a step limit of 3,000 steps, whereas the benchmark’s current protocol, used by both harness configurations, sets a step limit of 5,000 steps for these two tasks. Within 3,000 steps, no episode of either task succeeds in any configuration. Under a step limit of 5,000 steps, the harness with policy solves 3 of 20 Shop episodes with π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} , 1 with InternW0- Δ \Delta , and none of Bottle. These episodes raise the overall SR of the harness configurations from 52.4% to 53.0% and from 55.8% to 56.0%, respectively.

paragraphs.en: The frequencies of disruptions and grip losses in Section 5 are computed from the finger gaps and commanded finger targets of both arms, recorded after every executed chunk of at most 8 physics steps, and from the stated reasons of all calls in the 510 direct-control episodes, including the segments resumed after an interruption. The finger gap of a hand is the summed opening of its two fingers, which reaches 88 mm when the hand is fully open, or 0.044 m per finger joint in state.gripper . A grip counts as closed on an object when, after a close command, the fingers come to rest between 2 and 80 mm apart over two samples at different timesteps, so that fingertips closed for pushing do not count, and as lost when the gap then collapses while the gripper is still commanded closed. A stated reason counts as reporting a disruption when it names a slip, a drop, a fall, a displacement, or a loss outside a preventive phrase such as “avoid” or “in case”, and words of an intended release such as “released” do not count. A loss counts as occurring in a grasp test when the reason of its call contains test, verify, confirm, or check as a whole word, or names a one-centimeter lift. In a random sample of 20 of the other losses, read together with the arm that loses the grip, 16 occur while an object is lifted or carried, 3 during door manipulation, and 1 during a placement.
paragraphs.zh: 第5节中的中断和抓持丢失的频次，是根据双臂的手指间隙和指令手指目标计算的，这些数据在每执行完一段最多8个物理步骤的动作块后记录；同时也根据510个直接控制回合中所有调用的所述原因计算，包括中断后恢复的部分。 一只手的手指间隙是其两根手指开口之和，手完全张开时达到88毫米，即 state.gripper 中每个手指关节0.044米。 当发出闭合指令后，手指在两个不同时间步的采样中间距停在2至80毫米之间，则视为对某物体完成闭合抓持，因此为推压而闭合指尖的情况不计入；若之后间隙在夹爪仍被指令闭合的情况下塌缩，则视为抓持丢失。 当所述原因提到滑动、掉落、坠落、位移或丢失，且不在“避免”或“以防”等预防性短语之内时，视为报告了一次中断；表示有意释放的词语如“已释放”不计入。 当丢失调用的原因中以整词形式包含 test、verify、confirm 或 check，或提到一次一厘米的抬起时，该丢失视为发生在抓取测试中。 在对其余丢失中随机抽取的20个样本中，结合丢失抓持的那条机械臂来解读，有16个发生在物体被抬起或搬运期间，3个发生在门体操作期间，1个发生在放置期间。

paragraphs.en: The speed measures of Section 5.5 use the same chunk records, from all 510 episodes under direct control and from the segments of π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} in all 510 episodes of the harness with π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} , as listed in Table B.5 . Between consecutive chunks of one command, the wrist rotation is the angle between the measured EEF orientations of an arm, and the joint speed is the largest change of any arm joint, both divided by the executed physics steps. The two controllers differ in the tail of the rotation rates, as a single command of the agent can complete a large reorientation within a few chunks. In 38 commands, spread over 31 episodes, a wrist turns through 90 ∘ or more within 24 physics steps, whereas no segment of π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} reaches this threshold. Most of these commands reorient or reposition the hand for a new approach. Fast joint motion shows the same contrast, as transitions above 0.08 rad per physics step occur more than five times as often under direct control.
paragraphs.zh: 第 5.5 节的速度测量使用相同的分块记录，即来自直接控制下全部 510 个回合的分块记录，以及来自带 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 的测试框架中全部 510 个回合内 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 的各片段的分块记录，如表 B.5 所列。 在同一命令的相邻分块之间，腕部旋转是一条手臂所测末端执行器（EEF）朝向之间的夹角，关节速度是任一手臂关节的最大变化量，两者均除以所执行的物理步数。 这两个控制器在旋转速率的尾部上有所不同，因为智能体的单个命令可以在几个分块内完成大幅度的重新定向。 在分布于 31 个回合的 38 个命令中，有腕部在 24 个物理步内转过 90 ∘ 或更多角度的情况，而 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 的任何片段都未达到该阈值。 这些命令中的大多数是为新的接近动作而重新定向或重新定位手部。 快速关节运动呈现出同样的对比，因为超过每物理步 0.08 弧度的转变在直接控制下出现的频率是五倍以上。

paragraphs.en: Aggregate differences between configurations are tested with a bootstrap over episodes within each task (5,000 resamples), which keeps the task composition fixed, while single-task differences use exact McNemar tests with Holm correction over the 26 tasks. For the harness with π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} against direct control, the 95% SR interval is [ + 2.0 , + 10.5 ] [+2.0,+10.5] points when episodes are resampled within each task and [ − 2.5 , + 15.6 ] [-2.5,+15.6] when tasks are resampled, and the score interval is [ + 0.006 , + 0.071 ] [+0.006,+0.071] . By group, the SR intervals are [ + 6.8 , + 19.0 ] [+6.8,+19.0] for long-horizon, [ + 3.6 , + 19.3 ] [+3.6,+19.3] for tabletop, [ − 8.6 , + 3.2 ] [-8.6,+3.2] for short-horizon, and [ − 11.3 , + 3.8 ] [-11.3,+3.8] for high-precision tasks, and the score interval for high-precision tasks is [ − 0.163 , − 0.029 ] [-0.163,-0.029] . The gain of the harness with InternW0- Δ \Delta over direct control is significant under both resampling schemes, and on the short-horizon tasks this configuration also exceeds InternW0- Δ \Delta alone under both. After Holm correction over the 26 tasks, Glass into glassbox and Dishwasher rise significantly over direct control with either tool, Teacup, saucer & teapot falls significantly with π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} , and against InternW0- Δ \Delta alone, the corresponding harness configuration gains significantly on Apple from shelf and Perfume to cosmetics rack while losing significantly on Shop.
paragraphs.zh: 配置之间的聚合差异通过对每个任务内的回合（episode）进行自助法（bootstrap，5,000 次重采样）检验，从而保持任务构成固定，而单任务差异则使用对 26 个任务施加 Holm 校正的精确 McNemar 检验。 对于使用 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 的 harness 与直接控制的对比，当在每个任务内重采样回合时，95% SR 区间为 [ + 2.0 , + 10.5 ] [+2.0,+10.5] 个百分点，当重采样任务时为 [ − 2.5 , + 15.6 ] [-2.5,+15.6]，分数区间为 [ + 0.006 , + 0.071 ] [+0.006,+0.071]。 按任务组划分，SR 区间在长时程任务上为 [ + 6.8 , + 19.0 ] [+6.8,+19.0]，在桌面任务上为 [ + 3.6 , + 19.3 ] [+3.6,+19.3]，在短时程任务上为 [ − 8.6 , + 3.2 ] [-8.6,+3.2]，在高精度任务上为 [ − 11.3 , + 3.8 ] [-11.3,+3.8]，且高精度任务的分数区间为 [ − 0.163 , − 0.029 ] [-0.163,-0.029]。 使用 InternW0- Δ \Delta 的 harness 相对于直接控制的增益在两种重采样方案下都显著，且在短时程任务上，该配置在两种方案下也都超过单独的 InternW0- Δ \Delta。 在对 26 个任务进行 Holm 校正后，无论使用哪种工具，Glass into glassbox 和 Dishwasher 都显著高于直接控制，Teacup, saucer & teapot 在使用 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 时显著下降，而相对于单独的 InternW0- Δ \Delta，对应的 harness 配置在 Apple from shelf 和 Perfume to cosmetics rack 上显著提升，同时在 Shop 上显著下降。

paragraphs.en: The VLA tool is the π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} checkpoint fine-tuned on the EBench training set that appears as π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} on the leaderboard. A call executes 1–300 physics steps. The policy predicts 50 absolute joint and gripper targets per inference and replans every 30 steps under the fixed task instruction, and control returns to the agent after the requested steps with the same observations as an EEF command. The agent’s other tools and its prompt are those of Appendix A .
paragraphs.zh: VLA 工具是在 EBench 训练集上微调的 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 检查点，在排行榜上显示为 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5}。 一次调用执行 1–300 个物理步。 该策略在固定任务指令下，每次推理预测 50 个绝对关节和夹爪目标，并每 30 步重新规划一次；在请求的步数结束后，控制权返回智能体，其观测方式与 EEF 命令相同。 智能体的其他工具及其提示词与附录 A 中的相同。

paragraphs.en: The WAM tool is an InternW0- Δ \Delta checkpoint ( Miao et al., 2026 ) post-trained on EBench data for 77,150 steps. It represents the robot by joint and EEF state and, in 10 denoising steps, predicts 32 absolute joint and gripper targets and base motions, without generating video at inference, of which the first 10 are executed before the next inference. Each inference is conditioned on the three camera views, the proprioceptive state, the first frame of the episode, and the frame 32 steps earlier, under the fixed task instruction. The harness opens one model session per episode with the episode’s initial observation and executes each 10-action chunk as 8 and 2 steps, so that the frame 32 steps back is observed within a call. During the first inferences after the agent’s own control, that frame is unavailable and is padded as at an episode start, which affects 4,276 of the 69,054 inferences. The agent invokes the policy 8.1 times per episode, with 135 inferences, against 45 inferences of π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} in the configuration with π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} . Its standalone evaluation ran the same checkpoint with the same horizon, execution length, and history on all 510 test episodes with the original inference loop in which the earlier frame is always observed. This standalone evaluation is the entry of InternW0- Δ \Delta on the public leaderboard.
paragraphs.zh: WAM 工具是一个在 EBench 数据上后训练了 77,150 步的 InternW0- Δ \Delta 检查点（Miao et al., 2026）。 它以关节和末端执行器（EEF）状态表示机器人，并在 10 个去噪步骤中预测 32 个绝对关节和夹爪目标以及底盘运动，在推理时不生成视频，其中前 10 个动作会被执行，然后才进行下一次推理。 每次推理都以三个相机视角、本体感知状态、回合的第一帧以及早 32 步的帧为条件，并在固定的任务指令下进行。 该测试框架为每个回合开启一个模型会话并传入该回合的初始观测，将每个 10 动作块按 8 步和 2 步执行，从而使得早 32 步的帧能在一次调用内被观测到。 在智能体自身控制后的首次推理中，该帧不可用，会像回合开始时那样进行填充，这在 69,054 次推理中影响了 4,276 次。 该智能体每回合调用策略 8.1 次，共 135 次推理，而在使用 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 的配置中，π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 的推理次数为 45 次。 其独立评估在全部 510 个测试回合上，使用相同的检查点、相同的时域、执行长度和历史，以始终能观测到较早帧的原始推理循环运行。 该独立评估是 InternW0- Δ \Delta 在公开排行榜上的参赛条目。

paragraphs.en: Table C.1 lists every task, ordered by the change in SR with π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} . The harness with π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} exceeds both the agent under direct control and π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} alone on ten tasks and falls below the better of the two on thirteen. The ten tasks are Apple from shelf, Apple to fruit bowl, Bowl to plate, Dish, Flip cup & collect cookies, Make sandwich, Perfume to cosmetics rack, Glass into glassbox, Utensils to holder, and Shop. On Shop, it solves 3 of 20 episodes at the 5,000-step limit, against none for π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} alone and none for the direct-control run at 3,000 steps. The harness with π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} loses 59 episodes that the agent solved under direct control. Of these, 11 come from Teacup, saucer & teapot, 6 from Fruit, and 5 each from Dish, Frame placement, and Microwave. Of the 91 episodes that it gains, 14 come from Glass into glassbox, 11 from Dishwasher, and 7 each from Detergent, Dish, and Flip cup & collect cookies. paragraphs.en: The policy step share of an episode is the fraction of its executed physics steps that the policy executes, with EEF waypoints and gripper commands counted as the agent’s steps, and the share of a task is the mean over its episodes. For Figure 8 a, the executed steps of each episode are divided into tenths, and the policy’s share is computed within each tenth. A policy invocation counts as a recovery request in Table 3 when its stated reason contains a whole-word match for a term of recovery, retrying, slipping, dropping, missing, displacement, re-approach, regrasp, or failure, as in “Recover slipped soap and realign a deeper centered grasp”. In a random sample of 40 calls coded in this way, 33 clearly ask the policy to recover from a disruption, 6 are ambiguous, and 1 is not a recovery request. Both harness configurations enter these measures with their Bottle and Shop episodes at 5,000 physics steps, as in Table 2 .
paragraphs.zh: 回合（episode）的策略步占比是指由策略执行的物理步在其全部已执行物理步中所占的比例，其中末端执行器（EEF）路径点和夹爪指令计入智能体的步数，任务（task）的占比则是其各回合的平均值。 对于图 8a，每个回合的已执行步数被划分为十等份，并在每一等份内计算策略的占比。 当一次策略调用的陈述理由中包含以下任一词汇的整词匹配——恢复（recovery）、重试（retrying）、打滑（slipping）、掉落（dropping）、丢失（missing）、偏移（displacement）、重新接近（re-approach）、重新抓取（regrasp）或失败（failure）——时，该调用在表 3 中计为一次恢复请求，例如「恢复打滑的肥皂并重新对齐一个更深的居中抓取」。 在按此方式标注的 40 次调用的随机样本中，33 次明确要求策略从干扰中恢复，6 次含义模糊，1 次不属于恢复请求。 两种测试框架（harness）配置在进入这些统计时，其 Bottle 和 Shop 回合均已达到 5,000 个物理步，与表 2 中一致。

paragraphs.en: Figure C.1 groups the per-task SRs of Table C.1 by the atomic skills that EBench annotates for each task. With π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} and InternW0- Δ \Delta alike, mean SR rises most on pushing, pressing, and pulling, by 21 to 70 percentage points, and sweeping improves by 17 and 24 points, respectively. Several tasks require more than one of these skills, as Dishwasher counts toward pushing, pulling, and sweeping, and Glass into glassbox accounts for most of the increase on pressing. Insertion is the only skill whose mean SR drops in both harness configurations, from 36.7% under direct control to 30.0% with π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} and 26.7% with InternW0- Δ \Delta , while the two policies alone reach 23.3% and 18.3%. On handover, the harness with InternW0- Δ \Delta reaches 45.0% against 65.0% for InternW0- Δ \Delta alone, its largest shortfall against the standalone policy among the skills.
paragraphs.zh: 图 C.1 将表 C.1 中各任务的 SR（成功率）按 EBench 为每个任务标注的原子技能进行分组。 与 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 和 InternW0- \Delta \Delta 类似，平均 SR 在推、按和拉任务上提升最多，达 21 至 70 个百分点，清扫任务则分别提升 17 和 24 个百分点。 有若干任务需要不止一项这类技能，例如 Dishwasher 同时计入推、拉和清扫，而 Glass into glassbox 则占了按压任务上大部分的提升。 插入是唯一在两种框架配置下平均 SR 均下降的技能，从直接控制下的 36.7% 降至使用 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 时的 30.0% 和使用 InternW0- \Delta \Delta 时的 26.7%，而这两个策略单独使用时分别达到 23.3% 和 18.3%。 在递交任务上，配合 InternW0- \Delta \Delta 的框架达到 45.0%，而 InternW0- \Delta \Delta 单独使用时为 65.0%，这是各技能中相对独立策略的最大差距。

paragraphs.en: An episode is classified as agent-terminated when the agent stops before the step limit without succeeding. Phrase rules assign its final message to either an unconfirmed completion claim or a reported failure, and a manual check of ten episodes per run confirms this assignment. Table C.2 follows every episode of the agent under direct control to the same scene in each harness configuration. The two harness configurations newly fail 108 episodes that the agent solved under direct control: 59 with π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} and 49 with InternW0- Δ \Delta , on 85 distinct test episodes. Each of these episodes was read call by call, with the executor, the finger widths before and after, the base motion, and the agent’s stated reason of every call. Each was then assigned the incident after which the unfinished stage was never completed, as Table C.3 lists. Each agent-terminated episode is assigned the decisive incident preceding termination: a slip of the agent’s grasp, a loss around a policy segment, or an unmet stage behind a completion claim. A grip counts as held when the fingers come to rest between 2 and 80 mm apart over two samples at different timesteps while commanded closed, and as lost when it collapses while still commanded closed, and a reported slip is a stated reason coded as in Appendix B.2 . An unmaintained grasp is an agent command that follows a policy segment and leaves an arm holding an object unspecified rather than closing it, so that the arm holds its measured finger width. Unmaintained grasps are counted per arm, so the 338 and 316 of Section 6.4 fall in 337 and 313 agent commands. The comparison in Section 6.4 counts unspecified holding arms after the agent’s own commands within the same configuration, and its stratified odds ratios use the Mantel–Haenszel estimator over the tasks on which both kinds occur.
paragraphs.zh: 当智能体在步数上限之前停止且未取得成功时，该回合被归类为智能体终止。 短语规则将其最终消息归入未确认的完成声明或已报告的失败之一，并通过对每次运行抽取十个回合进行人工核查来确认这一归类。 表 C.2 在每种测试框架配置下，对受直接控制的智能体的每个回合跟踪到同一场景。 两种测试框架配置新出现 108 个受直接控制的智能体原本能解决的回合的失败：其中 59 个使用 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} ，49 个使用 InternW0- Δ \Delta ，涉及 85 个不同的测试回合。 这些回合中的每一个都被逐次调用地阅读，包括执行器、调用前后的手指宽度、底盘运动，以及智能体对每次调用所述的理由。 随后为每个回合指定其未完成阶段之后再未被完成的那一事件，如表 C.3 所列。 每个智能体终止的回合都被指定终止前的决定性事件：智能体抓取的滑落、策略片段附近的丢失，或完成声明背后未达成的阶段。 当在仍被指令闭合的情况下，手指在两个不同时间步的采样中介于 2 至 80 毫米之间并趋于静止时，抓取计为保持；当在仍被指令闭合的情况下抓取塌陷时，计为丢失；而报告的滑落是指按附录 B.2 编码的所述理由。 未维持的抓取是指智能体的一条指令，它跟在策略片段之后，使一只臂保持对物体的夹持状态未加指定而非将其闭合，从而使该臂保持其测得的手指宽度。 未维持的抓取按臂计数，因此第 6.4 节中的 338 和 316 落入 337 和 313 条智能体指令。 第 6.4 节中的比较在同一配置内对智能体自身指令之后的未指定夹持臂进行计数，其分层比值比使用 Mantel–Haenszel 估计量，并在两类事件都出现的任务上进行计算。

paragraphs.en: Table C.5 compares successful and unsuccessful episodes of the two harness configurations. A motion command is a call of the EEF interface, the gripper command, or the policy, and a transition is a change of executor between two consecutive motion commands. Pooled over episodes, the number of transitions correlates with failure, with point-biserial correlations of r = 0.42 r=0.42 and r = 0.44 r=0.44 , and within the 23 and 18 tasks with both outcomes, unsuccessful episodes make more transitions on 22 and 17 tasks (Wilcoxon signed-rank p = 2.1 × 10 − 4 p=2.1\times 10^{-4} and 1.5 × 10 − 5 1.5\times 10^{-5} ). They also issue more motion commands on every one of these tasks, with fewer transitions per motion command on 17 of the 23 tasks ( p = 0.015 p=0.015 ) and 15 of the 18 ( p = 0.06 p=0.06 ). Episodes with a recovery request to the policy fail in 75.5% and 72.0% of cases, against 15.8% and 16.8% without one. Of the 251 and 239 episodes with a disruption report, 227 and 200 contain a recovery request.

paragraphs.en: Using the held state and the losses defined in Appendix B.2 , every physics step between two samples of a held arm counts as a held arm-step of the executor of its call, and rates are given per 1,000 held arm-steps. The harness with π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} holds objects for 278,496 arm-steps under the policy and 146,922 under the agent, with 176 and 321 losses, corresponding to rates of 0.63 and 2.18 per 1,000 held arm-steps. With InternW0- Δ \Delta , the corresponding values are 262,037 and 142,024 arm-steps, with 189 and 315 losses, or 0.72 and 2.22 per 1,000. Of the agent’s losses, 193 and 173 fall in grasp-test calls, and outside these calls the agent’s rates are 0.87 and 1.00. Under direct control, 811 losses over 447,352 held arm-steps give 1.81 per 1,000, and 1.05 outside grasp tests. Among the tasks with more than 2,000 held arm-steps under both executors, the agent’s rate exceeds the policy’s on 13 of 16 tasks with π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} and 15 of 18 with InternW0- Δ \Delta .
paragraphs.zh: 使用保持状态以及附录 B.2 中定义的损失，被保持机械臂两次采样之间的每个物理步都算作其调用执行器的一个被保持机械臂步，比率按每 1,000 个被保持机械臂步给出。 配有 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 的测试框架在策略下保持物体 278,496 个机械臂步，在智能体下保持 146,922 个机械臂步，损失分别为 176 和 321，对应比率为每 1,000 个被保持机械臂步 0.63 和 2.18。 使用 InternW0- Δ \Delta 时，对应数值为 262,037 和 142,024 个机械臂步，损失为 189 和 315，即每 1,000 个中 0.72 和 2.22。 在智能体的损失中，有 193 和 173 次发生在抓取测试调用中，在这些调用之外，智能体的比率为 0.87 和 1.00。 在直接控制下，447,352 个被保持机械臂步中共有 811 次损失，即每 1,000 个中 1.81，抓取测试之外为 1.05。 在两种执行器下被保持机械臂步均超过 2,000 的任务中，智能体的比率在 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 下于 16 个任务中的 13 个超过策略，在 InternW0- Δ \Delta 下于 18 个任务中的 15 个超过策略。

paragraphs.en: Prompt caching dominates the API-equivalent cost of every configuration (Table C.6 ). On each request, the agent resends the growing episode context, including the instructions, the demonstration, earlier observations, and tool results, so most of the input repeats an earlier prefix from the same episode and is billed at the cached-input rate. At the Standard tariff of GPT-6-Astra (USD 10, 1, 12.5, and 50 per million uncached input, cached input, cache-write, and output tokens), cached input covers 91.5–97.0% of the input tokens and still accounts for 44.0–70.5% of the cost per episode despite its tenfold discount. The recorded tokens cost USD 7.82 per episode under direct control and 2.63 and 3.06 in the harness with π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} and with InternW0- Δ \Delta , corresponding to 16.82, 4.99, and 5.49 per success. For 44 direct-control episodes the final token record is missing, and the direct-control values here, in Figure 9 , and in Section 5.3 count the recorded tokens. In all three configurations, token use rises with the number of tool calls, with Pearson correlations of 0.88 under direct control and 0.94 and 0.87 in the harness with π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} and with InternW0- Δ \Delta . No request exceeds the 272k input tokens above which the tariff raises input and cache rates twofold and output rates by half. Only the direct-control run records cache writes, because part of its episodes ran through the API rather than the subscription route, which reports none.
paragraphs.zh: 提示缓存（prompt caching）主导了所有配置的 API 等效成本（表 C.6）。 在每次请求中，智能体都会重新发送不断增长的回合（episode）上下文，包括指令、示范、先前的观察结果和工具结果，因此大部分输入都重复了同一回合中较早的前缀，并按缓存输入费率计费。 按 GPT-6-Astra 的标准费率（每百万未缓存输入、缓存输入、缓存写入和输出 token 分别为 10、1、12.5 和 50 美元），缓存输入占输入 token 的 91.5–97.0%，尽管享有十倍折扣，其仍占每回合成本的 44.0–70.5%。 在直接控制下，记录的 token 每回合花费 7.82 美元，而在使用 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 的执行框架（harness）和使用 InternW0- Δ \Delta 的执行框架下分别为 2.63 和 3.06 美元，折合每次成功 16.82、4.99 和 5.49 美元。 有 44 个直接控制回合的最终 token 记录缺失，此处以及图 9 和第 5.3 节中的直接控制数值均按已记录的 token 计算。 在全部三种配置中，token 用量随工具调用次数的增加而上升，与工具调用次数的 Pearson 相关系数在直接控制下为 0.88，在使用 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 和 InternW0- Δ \Delta 的执行框架下分别为 0.94 和 0.87。 没有任何请求超过 272k 输入 token 的阈值，超过该阈值后费率会将输入和缓存费率提高一倍，输出费率提高一半。 只有直接控制运行记录了缓存写入，因为其部分回合是通过 API 而非订阅渠道运行的，而订阅渠道不报告缓存写入。

paragraphs.en: Figure D.6 compares rollouts of the GPT-6-Astra-based agent, π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} , and OpenWAM- α \alpha on the two tasks summarized in Section 5.6 . In Teacup, saucer & teapot (Figure D.6 a), the agent first approaches the cup handle and refines its wrist and gripper configuration over successive attempts before grasping and placing the cup onto the saucer. When subsequent manipulation of the teapot inadvertently displaces the cup from the saucer, the agent detects that the completed subgoal has been invalidated, re-grasps the cup, and restores it to the saucer rather than continuing the remaining action sequence. By contrast, π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} repeatedly approaches and retracts without completing the cup transfer, whereas OpenWAM- α \alpha fails to grasp the cup and proceeds to place the teapot onto the tray while leaving the cup off the saucer.
paragraphs.zh: 图 D.6 对比了基于 GPT-6-Astra 的智能体、π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 以及 OpenWAM- α \alpha 在 5.6 节所总结的两个任务上的执行轨迹。 在「茶杯、茶托与茶壶」（图 D.6 a）中，智能体首先接近杯柄，并在多次尝试中逐步调整手腕和夹爪的姿态，然后抓起茶杯并将其放到茶托上。 当随后对茶壶的操作不小心使茶杯从茶托上移位时，智能体检测到已完成的子目标被破坏，于是重新抓起茶杯并将其放回茶托，而不是继续执行剩余的动作序列。 相比之下，π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 反复接近又后退，未能完成茶杯的转移；而 OpenWAM- α \alpha 未能抓起茶杯，径直将茶壶放到托盘上，却让茶杯留在茶托之外。

sents.en: When subsequent manipulation of the teapot inadvertently displaces the cup from the saucer, the agent detects that the completed subgoal has been invalidated, re-grasps the cup, and restores it to the saucer rather than continuing the remaining action sequence.
sents.zh: 当随后对茶壶的操作不小心使茶杯从茶托上移位时，智能体检测到已完成的子目标被破坏，于是重新抓起茶杯并将其放回茶托，而不是继续执行剩余的动作序列。

sents.en: By contrast, π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} repeatedly approaches and retracts without completing the cup transfer, whereas OpenWAM- α \alpha fails to grasp the cup and proceeds to place the teapot onto the tray while leaving the cup off the saucer.
sents.zh: 相比之下，π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 反复接近又后退，未能完成茶杯的转移；而 OpenWAM- α \alpha 未能抓起茶杯，径直将茶壶放到托盘上，却让茶杯留在茶托之外。

paragraphs.en: In Glass into glassbox (Figure D.6 b), although the agent uses both arms to place the glasses into the open case, its subsequent adjustments fail to fold the temples fully inward, leaving a protruding temple that prevents the lid from closing despite repeated corrective pushes. By comparison, π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} places the glasses into the case and folds both temples compactly (though leaving the lid open), while OpenWAM- α \alpha completes both temple folding and lid closure.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Glass into glassbox 任务中（图 D.6 b），尽管智能体用双臂将眼镜放入打开的眼镜盒，但其后续调整未能将镜腿完全折入，导致镜腿外凸，即使反复进行纠正性推动也无法合上盒盖。 相比之下，π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 能将眼镜放入盒中并紧凑地折起两条镜腿（但盒盖保持打开），而 OpenWAM- α \alpha 则同时完成了镜腿折叠和盒盖闭合。

paragraphs.en: Figure D.7 shows keyframes from the paired evaluation with and without the annotated demonstration across all 20 test episodes of Frame placement and Gear installation (Section 5.6 ). On Frame placement (1/20 successes zero-shot vs. 13/20 with the demonstration, mean score 0.283 vs. 0.800), under zero-shot control the agent reaches and displaces the frame, but repeatedly adjusts its approach trajectory and wrist orientation without achieving stable placement. When conditioned on the demonstration, the agent coordinates both grippers to hold and transfer the frame in 17 of 20 episodes (including all 13 successful episodes, compared with 1 of 20 under zero-shot control) and positions the frame upright against the pen holder (Figure D.7 a). On Gear installation (3/20 successes under both conditions), without the demonstration the agent grasps and lifts the gear but leaves it outside the assembly region, whereas with the demonstration it brings the gear between the two mounted gears and lowers it, but it scores no stage in 15 of the 20 episodes (Figure D.7 b).
paragraphs.zh: 图 D.7 展示了在 Frame placement（框架放置）和 Gear installation（齿轮安装）全部 20 个测试回合中，有标注示范与无标注示范配对评估的关键帧。 在 Frame placement 上（零样本 1/20 成功 vs. 有示范时 13/20 成功，平均得分 0.283 vs. 0.800），在零样本控制下，智能体能够到达并移动框架，但反复调整其接近轨迹和手腕朝向，始终无法实现稳定放置。 在以示范为条件时，智能体在 20 个回合中的 17 个回合里协调两只夹爪共同抓握并转移框架（包括全部 13 个成功回合，相比之下零样本控制下仅为 20 个中的 1 个），并将框架竖直靠在笔筒上（图 D.7 a）。 在 Gear installation 上（两种条件下均为 3/20 成功），没有示范时，智能体能够抓取并提起齿轮，但将其留在了装配区域之外；而有示范时，智能体将齿轮带到两个已安装的齿轮之间并放下，但在 20 个回合中的 15 个回合里未获得任何阶段得分（图 D.7 b）。

paragraphs.en: The direct-control episodes of Appendix D illustrate three failure categories: an unconfirmed completion claim, an object lost beyond the reachable workspace, and a long-horizon task that ends with partial credit. Figure E.1 presents three episodes in the harness with policy on scenes that the agent solved under direct control, covering an unconfirmed completion claim, an unrecovered object loss, and a completed stage undone by a subsequent policy segment. The call-by-call records report the executor, the physics steps, the finger opening as defined in Appendix B.2 , and the agent’s stated reason.
paragraphs.zh: 附录 D 的直接控制片段说明了三类失败：一个未经确认的完成声明、一个丢失在可达工作空间之外的物体，以及一个仅获得部分分数的长时程任务。 图 E.1 展示了策略在测试框架中运行的三个片段，所用场景是该智能体在直接控制下成功解决过的，涉及一个未经确认的完成声明、一次未能恢复的物体丢失，以及一个被后续策略片段破坏的已完成阶段。 逐次调用记录报告了执行器、物理步数、附录 B.2 中定义的手指张开度，以及该智能体陈述的原因。

paragraphs.en: The stated reasons below come from the successful Flip cup & collect cookies episode discussed in Section 6.5 .
paragraphs.zh: 以下所述理由来自 6.5 节中讨论的成功完成 Flip cup & collect cookies 任务的那次对话（episode）。

paragraphs.en: Like the direct-control Dishwasher episode of Figure D.5 a, the Gear installation episode of Figure E.1 a with π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} ends with an unconfirmed completion claim. The agent closes the left hand on the gear hub and lifts the gear by 1 cm (calls 3 and 4, finger opening 29.9 and 30.0 mm), then invokes π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} for transport and seating in three segments of 180, 180, and 120 physics steps. In the second segment (call 6, stated reason “Continue fine alignment and seating of the blue gear on the middle axis”), π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} opens the left fingers from 29.9 to 86.2 mm beside the large gear. The agent then withdraws the open left hand and closes it (calls 8 and 9), requesting only the overview image for both commands, in which the board occupies a small part of the frame. It ends the episode at 828 physics steps with the final message “The blue gear is in the middle position between the white gears and remained there after the hand withdrew”, and the episode scores 0.5. On the same scene, the agent under direct control releases the gear, inspects the assembly from a more vertical wrist view (call 12), re-approaches the hub to correct a forward offset from the spindle (call 13), and withdraws only after the spindle becomes visible through the gear bore (call 16), solving the scene in 821 physics steps.
paragraphs.zh: 与图 D.5 a 的直接控制洗碗机情节类似，图 E.1 a 中使用 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 的齿轮安装情节也以一个未经验证的完成声明告终。 智能体用左手闭合抓住轮毂，将齿轮抬起 1 厘米（调用 3 和 4，手指张开 29.9 和 30.0 毫米），然后调用 π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 分三段（180、180 和 120 个物理步）进行搬运和安放。 在第二段（调用 6，所述理由为「继续将蓝色齿轮在中轴上精细对齐并安放」）中，π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} 在大齿轮旁将左手指从 29.9 毫米张开到 86.2 毫米。 随后智能体撤回张开的左手并将其闭合（调用 8 和 9），两条指令都只请求了俯视全景图像，而电路板在画面中只占一小部分。 它在 828 个物理步时以最终消息「蓝色齿轮位于白色齿轮之间的中间位置，并且在手撤回后仍保持在那里」结束该情节，情节得分为 0.5。 在同一场景中，直接控制下的智能体松开齿轮，从更垂直的腕部视角检查装配（调用 12），重新接近轮毂以纠正相对主轴的前向偏移（调用 13），并且只有在主轴透过齿轮孔可见之后才撤回（调用 16），在 821 个物理步内完成该场景。

paragraphs.en: In the recorded episodes, an object that leaves the reachable workspace is not recovered for the rest of the episode, as when the apple of Figure D.4 b falls and the agent under direct control searches outside the workspace. In the Detergent episode of Figure E.1 b, the agent drops the first bottle to the floor when it resumes control during a bimanual handover. InternW0- Δ \Delta closes the right hand on the first bottle while the left hand still holds it (call 4, 250 physics steps), ending with a fully closed finger command and a measured finger opening of 32.9 mm. The agent then opens the left hand (call 5) without commanding the right hand to stay closed, so the right fingers remain at their measured opening of 32.9 mm (Section 6.4 ), and the bottle tilts in the right hand while the left hand opens. In the 1 cm lift test that follows (call 6, stated reason “Check whether the receiving hand retained the bottle using a small lift”), the right fingers close from 32.8 to 2.2 mm within the first 8 physics steps, and the bottle falls from the counter to the floor. InternW0- Δ \Delta places the two other bottles in the basket by physics step 2,348, but the next 20 calls (calls 19 to 38) and 2,020 physics steps fail to recover the bottle on the floor: seven EEF waypoints directed toward the floor end 11 to 20 cm from their targets, and three InternW0- Δ \Delta segments of 300 physics steps each end with the fingers closed at 0.0 to 0.1 mm. The agent ends the episode at 4,368 physics steps with the final message “The blue/red bottle fell to the floor, and recovery attempts failed”, and the episode scores 0.67. Under direct control, the agent solves the same scene in 1,681 physics steps, carrying each bottle in the left hand without a transfer between the hands.
paragraphs.zh: 在录制的回合中，物体一旦离开可及工作空间，在该回合剩余时间内便无法被找回，例如图 D.4 b 中的苹果掉落后，直接控制下的智能体在工作空间之外搜索。 在图 E.1 b 的洗涤剂回合中，智能体在双臂交接过程中恢复控制时，将第一个瓶子掉到了地板上。 InternW0- Δ \Delta 在左手仍握着第一个瓶子时用右手合拢（调用 4，250 个物理步），最终以完全闭合的手指指令结束，测得的手指开度为 32.9 mm。 智能体随后打开左手（调用 5），但没有命令右手保持闭合，因此右手指保持在测得的 32.9 mm 开度（见第 6.4 节），当左手打开时，瓶子在右手中倾斜。 在随后的 1 cm 抬升测试中（调用 6，所述理由为“通过小幅抬升检查接收手是否仍握住瓶子”），右手指在前 8 个物理步内从 32.8 mm 闭合到 2.2 mm，瓶子从台面掉到地板上。 InternW0- Δ \Delta 在第 2,348 个物理步将另外两个瓶子放入篮子，但接下来的 20 次调用（调用 19 至 38）和 2,020 个物理步都未能找回地板上的瓶子：七次朝向地板的 EEF 路径点终点距离目标 11 至 20 cm，三次 InternW0- Δ \Delta 片段各持续 300 个物理步，均以手指闭合在 0.0 至 0.1 mm 处结束。 智能体在第 4,368 个物理步结束该回合，最终消息为“蓝色/红色瓶子掉到了地板上，恢复尝试失败”，该回合得分为 0.67。 在直接控制下，智能体用 1,681 个物理步解决了同一场景，全程用左手搬运每个瓶子，无需在双手之间交接。

paragraphs.en: Figure D.2 b shows a Bottle episode under direct control that ends with partial credit. In the harness with policy, a policy segment can also undo a stage that is already complete, because the post-trained policy receives the fixed task instruction without a record of the completed stages, as analyzed in Section 6.7 . In the Teacup, saucer & teapot episode of Figure E.1 c, five segments of π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} at the cup (calls 2, 4, and 5) and at the teapot (calls 22 and 24) end with the right hand empty and take 540 of the first 1,602 physics steps. Between those segments, the agent completes the cup placement itself, grasping the cup, releasing it on the saucer at physics step 994 (call 20), and verifying the placement (call 21). Its own handle grasp of the teapot holds at a 9.6 mm finger opening in the lift test (call 31), but the fingers close to 0.0 mm as the teapot is lifted clear (call 32). The agent invokes π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} for recovery with the stated reason “reapproach shifted handle with learned alignment” (call 34, 180 physics steps). In this segment, the hand descends beside the teapot, the saucer tips up under it, and the cup falls and comes to rest upside down on the table, undoing the earlier placement. The agent then tests the new contact as a teapot grasp (call 36) and releases it (call 37), and the episode runs until the step limit of 2,000 physics steps inside a final segment of π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} with the stated reason “Recover displaced cup and saucer” (call 38). The episode scores 0. Under direct control, the agent solves the same scene in 1,631 physics steps.

paragraphs.en: Figure E.3 shows a Shop episode in the harness with InternW0- Δ \Delta that fails although InternW0- Δ \Delta alone completes the same scene in 4,166 physics steps. The failure begins when the small carton drops in a handover between the hands that the agent delegates to the policy. The agent first lets the policy retry and then takes over, placing the carton on the destination belt with its own waypoints. After a can also slips in a later delegated handover, the agent again takes over, this time to secure the long box. Both recoveries succeed, but together with the failed handovers they use up the budget, so the episode reaches the 5,000-step limit while the agent carries a can across the scanner.
paragraphs.zh: 图 E.3 展示了测试框架中 InternW0- Δ \Delta 的一个 Shop 回合，该回合失败了，而 InternW0- Δ \Delta 单独执行同一场景时只需 4,166 个物理步即可完成。 失败始于智能体委托给策略的一次双手交接中，小纸箱掉落。 智能体先让策略重试，随后接管，用自己规划的路径点将纸箱放到目的地传送带上。 在之后一次委托交接中罐子也滑落之后，智能体再次接管，这次是为了固定长盒。 两次恢复都成功了，但连同失败的交接一起耗尽了预算，因此该回合在智能体正拿着罐子通过扫描器时达到了 5,000 步的上限。
